By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

This is an exciting opportunity to blend customer success and sales expertise to help customers realize the full potential of PagerDuty’s platform while driving revenue growth.

 Maintain strong product knowledge and deliver consultative guidance to drive configuration optimization and feature adoption.

title: Advertising Operations Manager
description:
Headquarters:  San Francisco Bay Area or New York (Remote)
 

  Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does:  play video games.  Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.   Ad Operations and Sales Analytics support Discord's ads business, partnering with Sales, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality campaign executions, impactful data insights, and go-to-market strategy across our advertising products. 
 As an Ad Operations Manager, you will play a crucial part in scaling our Ads business. You'll improve the efficiency and scale of campaign execution while contributing to deep-dive analyses that drive business growth and inform go-to-market strategy. You'll provide valuable feedback to Product and Engineering teams, directly impacting Discord's advertising capabilities while removing friction from customers' experience with our platform. 
  What You'll Be Doing  
 
 Ensuring ad campaigns are implemented and launched on time and to specification — including campaign parameters such as dates, targeting, tracking, impression/reach goals, geographies, and budget — working closely with Account Executives and Account Managers to align setups with client objectives 
 Providing hands-on technical support to key customers and Ad Sales partners, and owning the processes and escalation path (in partnership with Engineering) for issues related to platform integration and use 
 Partnering with Account Managers and technical teams to optimize campaign outcomes and maximize client ROI, including troubleshooting and A/B testing of messaging, creative, and targeting 
 Synthesizing campaign performance insights for internal stakeholders and clients — performance, trends, ROI, and actionable recommendations 
 Building and scaling automations and tooling (including AI/LLM-based workflows) that reduce manual effort and increase leverage across the team 
 Serving as the operational engine for multiple revenue-driving functions across the Discord Business Organization 
 
  What you should have  
 
 3–5+ years of experience in digital advertising, ad operations, or related roles 
 Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., LLM-based workflows, scripting/automation) to drive measurable efficiency gains in a professional environment 
 Comfort working with data and light scripting — SQL required; Python or similar strongly preferred — to build or maintain internal tooling and reporting pipelines 
 Demonstrated knowledge of a broad variety of ad technologies, campaign operation methodologies, and ad tracking/measurement solutions

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (all genders)
description:
Sunday Natural is one of Germany’s fastest-growing natural health brands, and our eCommerce platform is growing with it – today it serves 7 million monthly active users, runs on €400k of AWS per year, and supports a development organization of 30+ engineers. Every one of those numbers has moved sharply upward in the last few years, and all of them will keep moving.

You would be our first dedicated in-house Senior DevOps Engineer – and the two biggest engineering projects of the next two years are yours to help define and drive: bringing our entire infrastructure under Terraform, and strengthening the scalability, security and compliance posture across our cloud environments.

Your role

  • You shape the infrastructure vision. How we run, deploy, monitor and scale is yours to define, propose and defend.

  • You work alongside our two external partners as the in-house technical counterpart – building the architecture and standards together, and bringing the deep platform knowledge back into the company. As the platform grows, taking the technical direction of that group is a natural next step, and one we would actively support.

  • You own our AWS spend – €400k a year that currently has no dedicated owner, including where it goes and how we bring it down.

  • You are the escalation point. When production is at risk, you decide.

  • You report directly to the Head of eCommerce Platforms, with direct access to leadership for the decisions that need it.

title: Senior Data Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d) at LIQID, who will play a pivotal role in building and scaling data infrastructure that powers decision-making.

You will design scalable, high-performance data pipelines, ensure data integrity, and drive efficient data processing across the organization. Working closely with our Head of Data, Analytics Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will develop robust data architectures, enhance data security, and implement best practices that empower data-driven decision-making at scale.

This is not a role where you preserve what already exists. It is a role where you build what comes next. As LIQID scales beyond €4 billion in assets under management, the demands on our data infrastructure are growing fast. You will have real ownership over how we meet that challenge, with the autonomy to propose solutions and the backing to ship them.

title: Team Lead Software Production Support (m/f/d)
description:
At Quantum Systems, we are redefining the boundaries of autonomous drone technology. We develop and deploy some of the world’s most advanced UAVs, combining highly integrated hardware, embedded software, sensors, compute platforms, and production processes into reliable systems for demanding real-world missions.​

As part of our Software Production Support Team, you will work at the intersection of serial UAV production, embedded software, firmware deployment, production diagnostics, automation, and traceability. You will help ensure that every drone leaving production is equipped with the correct software, firmware, configuration, and documentation needed for safe and reliable operation.​

Between hands-on troubleshooting on the production floor, flashing microcontrollers and compute modules, analyzing system behavior, improving diagnostic workflows, developing production tools, and refining digital work instructions, you will play a key role in turning advanced UAV technology into stable, scalable, and efficient serial production

title: Test Automation Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
As a Test Automation Engineer (m/f/d), you will be an important part of our software team. You will design, optimize, and expand our test automation system to fully automate the release process and software quality of the ground station and our drone software.

In a highly skilled team, you will play a key role in pushing the boundaries of modern software solutions for our high-tech drones.

You will work closely with stakeholders from our software teams as well as adjacent departments (such as hardware development) to extend and improve the software testing pipeline.

By ensuring high code quality and streamlined deployment pipelines, you will support Quantum-Systems in its mission to become the leader for aerial data collection solutions with unmanned aerial systems (sUAV). 

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Develop a test strategy to validate our entire software stack for vertical take-off and landing aircraft (VTOL).

  • Create new end-to-end integration tests.

  • Review, challenge, and optimize existing test cases.

  • Proactively expand test coverage in a structured way to identify and push system limits.

  • Develop an automated test framework that enables developers to continuously extend the test suite.

  • Evaluate and develop AI-powered testing solutions, including AI agent-based systems, to automate test implementation, improve test generation, and increase the efficiency of our verification processes.

  • Work closely with development teams to further build out the test automation pipeline.



What you bring to the team:

  • A successfully completed degree in electrical engineering, computer science, or a comparable qualification (e.g., ISTQB certification)

  • 3+ years of experience in software testing or working in similar role

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
description:
Introduction

At a glance

  • Location &workmodel:Berlin, hybrid
  • Tech stack:Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester (KubeVirt), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph
  • Team:A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SREwe'rehiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware
  • Process:Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team

Why this role is special

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next.

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time.

You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next.

title: Applied Operations Research Engineer
description:
We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.

Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.

We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved.

Your mission

Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.

We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production, with its capacities, costs and constraints, and we compute the answer to "what should we do?" before the decision is made. Our engine turns that model into one artifact that both evaluates like a spreadsheet and optimizes like a solver. It sits between two worlds: the mathematics that makes the answer correct, and the product that has to make it usable by people who are not mathematicians.

That bridge is your mission. You work with our math and OR team to translate real customer problems into models, and you develop the engine that runs them.

We will not sugarcoat it: combinatorial search is unpredictable, customer data arrives messy, and some weeks a deadline sets the priority.

What you'll own

  • Customer models, end to end. Turn a planning problem, with its capacities, costs, lead times and shift plans, into a model whose answer a plant manager acts on. That includes the data it runs on: ERP and Excel exports, and catching the numbers that cannot be right before the c

title: Systemadministrator Linux (m/w/d)
description:
Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. 

Deine Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung

title: Customer Success Consultant
description: Je zit aan tafel bij een grote GGZ-instelling. Geen stopwatch die meeloopt, wel de tijd om echt te snappen waar ze tegenaan lopen. Bij CRS krijg je die ruimte. Als Consultant help je onze grootste klanten om meer uit hun EPD te halen, van de dagelijkse praktijk tot de declaraties die de zorg draaiende houden.      Wat ga je doen?    Jij bent het vaste gezicht voor een aantal van onze grootste klanten in de GGZ en Jeugdzorg. Je zorgt dat ze het maximale uit hun EPD halen, van de inrichting tot de dagelijkse praktijk en de declaraties die de zorg draaiende houden. Hoe beter jij ze helpt, hoe soepeler hun behandelaren werken en hoe meer grip ze krijgen op hun geldstroom. Je belangrijkste doel is waarde toevoegen en zorgen dat ze tevreden bij HCI CRS blijven.      Jouw taken:    Je bent het vaste aanspreekpunt en de gesprekspartner voor de grootste klanten: periodieke overleggen, meedenken over hun processen en uitzoeken wat nog niet is gedocumenteerd.  Je begeleidt de uitrol van nieuwe functionaliteiten en helpt klanten die ook echt te gebruiken, zodat de investering zich terugbetaalt.  Als tweede lijn achter de supportdesk pak je de lastigere vragen op en help je klanten inhoudelijk vooruit.  Declaratie- en facturatiestromen naar zorgverzekeraars pluis je uit, zodat klanten meer omzet en betere rapportages uit hun EPD halen.  Klantwensen en bugs leg je vast, je zet ze via DevOps door naar ons productteam en koppelt de status terug. Ook de kennisbank houd je up-to-date.  Je signaleert kansen om de klant verder te helpen en schakelt daarvoor met support, development en sales. Af en toe geef je een demo of webinar.       Over ons    Bij Health Cloud Initiative (HCI) werken ruim 250 collega's aan één doel: betere zorg, makkelijk geregeld. CRS bouwt daarvoor al ruim 25 jaar software voor de GGZ en jeugdzorg, nu met een flinke AI-versnelling. Onze software neemt behandelaren werk uit handen, zodat zij meer tijd overhouden voor hun patiënten. Dat is uiteindelijk waar jouw werk aan bijdraagt.  Je komt in een ervaren, hecht consultancyteam dat nauw samenwerkt met sales. De sfeer is ondernemend en persoonlijk. We werken hard en helpen elkaar, en we lachen net zo makkelijk om onszelf. Voor demo's en implementaties schakel je met sales, en je hebt collega's met veel kennis van de GGZ die hun netwerk en ervaring graag delen. Senior consultant Elianne helpt je op weg en zorgt dat je stap voor stap groeit, net als zij zelf van consultant naar senior is doorgegroeid. Je krijgt de ruimte om te ondernemen, mee te denken en zelf dingen op te pakken.      Wat bieden we jou?     Salaris: € 4.000,-- tot € 5.500,- bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur.  8% vakantiegeld en goede pensioenregeling.  Hybride werken: op onze fijne kantoren   in Wageningen of Amsterdam en 2 dagen vanuit huis.  25 vakantiedagen, de mogelijkheid om 10 dagen bij te kopen.  Reiskostenvergoeding, thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,45 per dag en thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 500,- per twee jaar.  Leren &a

title: Machine Learning Staff Engineer – ADAS Online
description:
We are building a high-performance ADAS Online team focused on advancing state-of-the-art machine learning and AI algorithms for scene understanding and environmental awareness. As ML Staff Engineer, you will drive the algorithmic direction of our present and future in-vehicle spatial awareness stack while remaining deeply hands-on in model design, experimentation, and performance improvement. You will contribute as a senior technical authority and mentor within a small, high-velocity team.

This spatial awareness stack will leverage modern transformer and end-to-end architectures to transform vehicle sensor data along with real-time 3D map data from the cloud into a 3D, semantically defined environment identifying all static and dynamic objects. This is a high-ownership technical role in a fast-moving, data-driven AI environment.


What You'll Do
  • Define and drive the technical direction for physical AI algorithms
  • Define and execute on a technical roadmap towards state-of-the-art reinforcement learning using physical AI world models.
  • Design, implement, and improve ML / vision transformer models for 3D awareness and planning. These include Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), Diffusion, object detection, multi-object tracking, semantic segmentation, and occupancy modeling
  • Architect multi-modal fusion approaches (camera, LiDAR, RADAR) to build 3D environments
  • Per the roadmap, identify where larger end-to-end models should replace more traditional approaches
  • Apply advanced ML techniques (Transformers, representation learning, large-scale models) to improve perception performance
  • Lead structured experimentation and benchmarking to deliver measurable gains in accuracy and robustness
  • Translate research ideas into reliable, scalable ML solutions
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to perception engineers

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager

Hybrid (UK-based) | Full-Time

Flexibility on how often you come into the office, as long as you're able to travel to the London office when required.

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Finance Manager to own the operational management of our finance function — accurate, timely management accounts, statutory accounts oversight, and the processes and controls that keep our finances reliable as we scale. You'll run month-end close, own balance sheet reconciliation and cash flow, lead the team responsible for AR/AP, payroll, VAT, and HMRC processes, and bring the analytical rigour that helps us make good financial decisions as we grow.

You'll also manage external relationships (auditors, solicitors, bankers), support external investment and funding activity, and run accounts across multiple business entities, including regulated entities in different geographies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Month-end close and reporting

title: Customer Success Manager (m/f/d) - EMEA
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your role

  • Own day-to-day client relationships across a portfolio of KAM accounts, building trusted partnerships with key stakeholders across research, insights, strategy, and increasingly at VP and Director level.

  • Develop a deep understanding of each client’s business priorities, use cases, and success metrics — and proactively connect Statista’s platform to the problems they are trying to solve.

  • Maintain an up-to-date account health picture for every account in your portfolio — usage trends, stakeholder changes, risk signals, and expansion indicators.

  • Be the client’s primary point of contact for onboarding, adoption, value realisation, and renewal — and the person they call when they want to get more from the platform.

title: Senior Product Manager - Human AI Collaboration (all genders)

  • Turn deep thinking into product behavior that's measurable and useful

HR tech. Employee analytics. Performance management. Personality profiling. Engagement optimization. Prompt engineering. Traditional UX research. wingmaite models conditions, not characteristics. No scoring people, no manipulating behavior, no inferring personality, no replacing human judgment.

Must-haves

Asiakkuuspäällikkönä vastaat yritysterveyden merkittävien valtakunnallisten suurasiakkuuksien johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä. Johdat asiakkuuksia aktiivisella otteella ja työlläsi varmistat asiakkaidemme terveyttä ja organisaatioiden menestystä nyt ja huomenna. Me teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Tavoitteenamme on olla inhimillinen työntekopaikka, jossa ammattilainen voi keskittyä olennaiseen. Panostamme lähijohtamiseen ja esihenkilötyöhön, jotta jokainen ammattilaisemme saa työssään tarvittavan tuen. Ammattirajat ylittävä tiimityö ja joustavuus tukevat arjen työtämme.  Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. description: About LeoVest Partners AG      LeoVest Partners AG is a Swiss independent EAM – Multi Family Office headquartered in Zurich with an office in Geneva. Beyond traditional asset management, LeoVest delivers dedicated, discreet and high-quality services.     We offer two proven investment philosophies. Our Active Investing approach is a contrarian, value-based strategy built on rigorous fundamental analysis, seeking undervalued opportunities through a disciplined building block framework and long-term investment horizon. Our Passive Investing approach follows a systematic four-factor model, combining Growth, Value, Momentum and Size factors to deliver diversified and cost-efficient market exposure.      Why do experienced Relationship Managers join LeoVest?      Every person has their own reasons.  Some are looking for greater entrepreneurial freedom.  Others want to become true partners rather than employees.  Many are looking for a firm with modern infrastructure, an outstanding team and a culture of partnership where decisions are made together. title: CRM Manager | Ecommerce & DTC
description: CRM Manager | Ecommerce & DTC | German-speaking    Remote in Germany | One week per month in Vienna    €60,000–€70,000      What if you could take ownership of CRM across six consumer brands, with the freedom to build the capability as the business grows?     Acquire is the exclusive search partner to a rapidly growing European DTC business. Its ecommerce operation currently generates approximately €9 million, with plans to reach €20 million over the next two to three years.     CRM will play a central role in that growth. The foundations are in place, including Klaviyo and a migration from Magento to commercetools, but there is significant scope to improve how the business acquires, retains and develops its customers.      The role   This is a hands-on position combining strategic ownership with practical execution. You will:   Build and optimise automated customer journeys  Develop customer segmentation and personalisation  Improve first-to-second purchase conversion  Increase retention, repeat purchase and reactivation  Manage email campaign planning and delivery  Use customer and commercial data to identify opportunities  Support the introduction of a new loyalty programme  Measure CRM revenue and commercial performance  Work across multiple brands, markets and ecommerce teams      You will have the freedom to shape the CRM roadmap while remaining close enough to the detail to build campaigns, automations and segments yourself.      About you   You will ideally bring:   Native or near-native German and professional English  Three to five years of meaningful CRM experience  Experience within ecommerce, DTC or a consumer-led digital business  Hands-on experience building lifecycle campaigns, automations and segments  A strong understanding of retention, repeat purchase and customer lifetime value  The ability to connect CRM activity with revenue and wider commercial performance  Confidence working directly within a CRM platform      Klaviyo experience would be particularly useful, although comparable platform experience will be considered. Subscription, loyalty or pet-sector experience would be helpful but is not essential.     This will suit someone who wants more than responsibility for campaign delivery. As the business grows, the intention is to build a broader CRM function around this role, creating a genuine opportunity to progress into team leadership.     You can be based remotely in Germany, provided you can spend one working week per month at the company’s Vienna office

title: CRM Strategy Manager RIF 100052

La posizione prevede una stretta collaborazione con il senior management, gli stakeholder locali e i team centrali con sede presso l’Headquarter. Gestire la governance delle performance di business del CRM, garantendo una pianificazione strutturata, il monitoraggio delle performance e una reportistica chiara dei principali KPI relativi alla clientela e alle performance commerciali. Solida conoscenza delle strategie CRM, dei principali canali di customer engagement, dei KPI e delle best practice.  Esperienza comprovata nell’utilizzo di piattaforme CRM e strumenti di analytics.  Esperienza nel settore dei Servizi Finanziari, e-commerce o business digitali costituisce un plus.  Ottime capacità di comunicazione.  Capacità di utilizzare strumenti di data analysis e soluzioni basate sull’Intelligenza Artificiale per ottimizzare il customer engagement e le performance CRM.  Ottima conoscenza professionale della lingua inglese.  Approccio agile, flessibile e orientato al cambiamento. title: Service- og personalechef - Kalundborg
description: Service- og personalechef  Har du en stærk lederprofil, interesse i personalepleje og -administration, og kan du løfte ansvaret for alle HR-relaterede opgaver i varehuset?  Som service- og personalechef i føtex indgår du i varehusets ledelse og refererer til varehuschefen.  Du har overblik og er en dygtig leder, der kan tænke bredt og strategisk, og som gennem udvikling af og uddelegering til dine medarbejdere kan skabe resultater og gode indkøbsoplevelser for vores kunder. Du har et stort overblik, der gør, at du kan sikre, at procedurer og retningslinjer bliver overholdt.   Bliv en del af sammenholdet i føtex    Hos føtex deler vi en vinderånd og en stolthed over at gøre det hele lidt mere lækkert. Vi er sammen om at give kunderne en ekstra god service og tilbyde de bedste varer i en indbydende butik med højt til loftet. Vi er dog ikke større end, at alle kender alle, så du kan se frem til at blive en del af et stort sammenhold og få en masse nye kolleger.   Dine opgaver og ansvarsområder      du skal sikre, at der bliver udfærdiget ansættelseskontrakter til alle medarbejdere  du har overordnet ansvar for elever og praktikanter i varehuset  du er overordnet lønansvarlig  du supporterer de øvrige ledere huset i anvendelsen af vores rekrutteringssystem  du er bemandingsansvarlig for serviceenheden  du er personaleansvarlig for medarbejdere i serviceenheden, så du skal fastholde og udvikle enhedens medarbejdere, rekruttere nye medarbejdere og afholde afdelingsmøder    Nøglen til denne stilling er stærk ledelse og godt overblik. For det er gennem god planlægning, strategisk tankegang og fokus på medarbejdernes trivsel og udvikling, du leverer de gode resultater.   Skab en karriere i en af Danmarks største varehuskæder    Vi ved, at når vores medarbejdere bliver dygtigere, så bliver føtex det også. Derfor bidrager vi hellere end gerne til din faglige udvikling, og hvis du mangler enkelte kompetencer eller har specifikke udviklingsønsker, tilbyder vi en lang række interne kurser som supplement til den daglige sparring.  Kan du løfte opgaven som service- og personalechef i føtex, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt gennem linket her på siden.   Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.    I 1960 åbnede Herman Salling den første føtex i Guldsmedgade i Aarhus og startede med det samme en indkøbsrevolution, der stadig er i gang. I dag er vi godt 15.000 kolleger, der brænder for at levere service; hurtigt, høfligt, trygt og troværdigt. Du kan komme med på holdet i et af vores over 90 varehuse eller 11 føtex food convenience-butikker. Vores historie er din vækst.

Nelle nostre creazioni, stile e qualità si intrecciano per creare emozioni uniche. title: Servicechef
description: Är du redo för nästa utmaning?    Får du energi av omväxling och snabbt tempo i en föränderlig miljö?  Nu söker vi en Servicechef till vår avdelning i Visby, som kan vara med och utveckla vår serviceverksamhet inom ventilation, VS, el, fastighetsdrift, säkerhet och automation.   Välkommen med din ansökan!    Ditt nya jobb   Som servicechef på Bravida har du ett helhetsansvar över vår serviceverksamhet, vilket innebär både ekonomi- och personalansvar. I dina arbetsgifter ingår:    Att utveckla och bevara kundrelationer  Att ansvara för avtal och ekonomiska resultat, teknisk kvalitet och dokumentation i uppdrag  Att organisera, leda och engagera medarbetare  Att arbeta med kalkyl och prognosarbete  Arbete med bland annat inköp, resursplanering och kvalitets- och arbetsmiljöarbete  Att vara delaktig i Bravidas förbättringsarbeten och utveckla serviceverksamheten     Som servicechef på Bravida får du frihet under ansvar. Vi tror på din förmåga att överträffa kundernas förväntningar genom din kunskap, ditt driv och ditt intresse.   Ditt nya team   På Bravida Visby är vi cirka 80 medarbetare inom entreprenad och service. Avdelningen leds av avdelningschefen, tillsammans med servicechefen som ansvarar för sitt team inom service, som består av cirka 40 medarbetare. Avdelningens uppdrag sträcker sig från entreprenader till mindre serviceuppdrag. Vår styrka är vår bredd av kompetens och vårt breda utbud av tjänster, helhetslösningar och ett nära samarbete mellan service och entreprenad. Vi är ett gott gäng som jobbar tätt tillsammans och som värdesätter att ha roligt på jobbet!   Vi söker dig som   Vi söker dig som sätter människan i centrum! Du är genuint intresserad av att utveckla både individer och team och du skapar en miljö där alla känner sig sedda, hörda och viktiga. Med tydlighet, omtanke och höga förväntningar inspirerar du medarbetarna att ta ansvar, samarbeta och prestera på sin högsta nivå. Du vet att de bästa resultaten skapas när människor trivs, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans.  Du har erfarenhet av servicearbete inom installationsbranschen samt har erfarenhet och intresse av säljarbete och att skapa goda kundrelationer. Vi ser gärna att du har teknisk examen eller motsvarande med flerårig erfarenhet inom ventilation och VS. Arbetet som servicechef kräver ofta snabba beslut och ageranden, vilket ställer krav på en stor problemlösningsförmåga och förmåga att kunna hantera flera uppgifter samtidigt. Du har också ett intresse och kunskaper inom ekonomi och uppföljning. Du behärskar Office-paketet och andra IT-verktyg väl. Det är viktigt att du har lokal förankring i Visby med omnejd. B-körkort är ett krav.   Bravida som arbetsgivare   På Bravida är vi stolta över att leverera känslan när allt bara fungerar. title: Kunnossapidonn työnjohtaja
description: Haluatko esihenkilörooliin, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen?  Salmen Metallilla työnjohtajana toimit kunnossapidon arjen keskiössä ja vaikutat suoraan asiakkaiden tuotannon sujuvuuteen, turvallisuuteen ja tehokkuuteen.      Tässä tehtävässä  yhdistyvät ihmisten johtaminen, kunnossapitotöiden koordinointi, projektien läpivienti sekä toiminnan jatkuva kehittäminen. Pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten kunnossapito- ja projektitehtävien parissa eri teollisuusympäristöissä ja näet konkreettisesti oman työsi vaikutukset asiakkaiden arjessa.  Salmen Metallilla kunnossapito on paljon enemmän kuin vikojen korjaamista. Olet mukana suunnittelemassa, priorisoimassa ja kehittämässä toimintaa yhdessä asiakkaiden, oman tiimin ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa. Saat vastuuta ja mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa siihen, miten työt tehdään nyt ja tulevaisuudessa.      Työnjohtajana johdat  noin 8–10 hengen osaavaa tiimiä, johon kuuluu kunnossapitoasentajia ja levyseppähitsaajia. Vastaat kunnossapitotöiden, asennusten ja projektien sujuvasta toteutuksesta sekä siitä, että työ etenee turvallisesti, laadukkaasti ja aikataulussa. Päivät koostuvat henkilöstön johtamisesta, resurssien suunnittelusta, asiakkaiden kanssa työskentelystä, käytännön ongelmanratkaisusta sekä erilaisten projektien koordinoinnista. Satunnaiset työmatkat Kuopion ulkopuolelle tuovat tehtävään mukavaa vaihtelua.      Tarjoamme sinulle  vastuullisen ja monipuolisen esihenkilötehtävän vakavaraisessa ja kasvavassa yrityksessä, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan toiminnan kehittämiseen. Saat tueksesi osaavan ja sitoutuneen tiimin sekä työyhteisön, jossa arvostetaan käytännönläheistä tekemistä, yhteistyötä ja halua kehittää toimintaa jatkuvasti. Työsuhde solmitaan joko Eilakaislan kautta tai suoraan Salmen Metallin palvelukseen.      Odotamme sinulta  kokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidon työnjohdosta sekä kykyä suunnitella, aikatauluttaa ja priorisoida töitä järjestelmällisesti. Menestyt tehtävässä, jos johdat tiimiäsi rauhallisella ja ratkaisukeskeisellä otteella, viihdyt vaihtelevissa tilanteissa ja nautit siitä, että pääset työskentelemään sekä ihmisten että teknisten kokonaisuuksien parissa. Soveltuva tekninen koulutus, kuten insinöörin tai teknikon tutkinto, tukee tehtävässä onnistumista. Työskentely tapahtuu pääosin suomeksi, ja englannin kielen perustaidot riittävät kansainvälisten asiakkaiden ja yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa toimimiseen.      Jos etsit tehtävää, jossa pääset yhdistämään esihenkilötyön, projektit, kunnossapidon asiantuntemuksen ja toiminnan kehittämisen, tämä voi olla juuri sinulle oikea seuraava askel urallasi. Works as a peer with the Global Operations Manager, ensuring field staff operate within established company/functional policies, procedures and guidelines. Ensures that established field service metrics are met. Recruits staff and plans for future succession. Develops strategies to protect install base from competitors by ensuring quality service delivery and industry high customer satisfaction. Ensures service readiness for all new customers by providing project management from contract initiation through implementation and ongoing support.      What you’ll be doing:    Operational Leadership    Take full ownership of field service delivery operations in Japan, maintaining clear oversight of service performance, team capability, and account health — including proactive identification and management of any accounts at risk.  Provides leadership and day to day oversight of field service delivery operations.  Manages all pro and reactive activities, ensuring all operational metrics that are set by the Area Vice President are met or exceeded.  Ensures compliance with established functional policies and procedures.  Ensures adequate staff with appropriate capabilities to meet company needs.  Conducts periodic assessment of productivity and implements corrective actions as needed.  Provides an annual written performance evaluation for each of his/her employees  Develops service plans for entry into new geographies.  Ensures local skillsets meet service requirements and recommends training or additional resources  Prepares and presents incident review reports when required  Conducts periodic assessments of productivity and implements corrective actions as needed  Manages a diverse and complex scope of support issues       Sales Partnership and Revenue Protection    Develops strong, interactive relationships with the sales organization and other strategic business units. title: 4534 サービスデザインリード（マネージドサービス領域）_TI
description: 職務内容 / Job duties  【事業・組織構成の概要】  【職務内容】  サービスデザイン領域の中核メンバーとして、大手企業の運用DX変革をリードいただきます。  顧客に寄り添いながら、NECが培ってきた知見やアセットを活用し、構想策定から運用設計、サービスデリバリまでを一気通貫で推進。クラウド、ServiceNow、AIを活用した次世代のIT運用モデルの実現に挑戦いただくポジションです。  ＜運用DXコンサルティング＞  ・金融・製造・流通など大手企業に対し、運用DX構想策定や運用高度化プロジェクトをリード  ＜運用設計・構築＞  ・ServiceNowやクラウドを活用した次世代運用モデル・サービスマネジメントプロセスの設計・構築をPMとしてリード  ＜サービスデリバリ＞  ・大規模ITサービスの運用立上げから安定稼働、継続的改善までを運用統括としてリード  ＜提案活動・サービス企画＞  ・新規提案、運用高度化提案、新たな運用DXサービスの企画・実現をリード  ＜チーム力強化・技術活用＞  ・組織力向上に向けた人材育成や、AI・自動化技術を活用したサービスデザイン・デリバリ業務変革を推進  【ポジションのアピールポイント】  サービスデザイングループの中核を担うリーダーとして、技術力とリーダーシップを発揮しながら、大手企業の運用DX変革を牽引いただくポジションです。  ・「運用する」だけでなく、「運用を変革する」ことに挑戦可能  ・大手企業の運用DX変革を、構想策定からサービスデリバリまで一気通貫でリード  ・担当案件を牽引しながら、後進育成や業務プロセス改善を通じて組織成長にも貢献  【キャリアパス】  ・運用DX変革を牽引するテクニカルリード・サービスデザインリーダーへ成長  ・クラウド、AI、ServiceNow等の先進技術を活用した次世代サービス設計スキルを習得  ・将来的には大規模案件のサービスマネージャ経験を経て、組織運営や事業成長を担うマネジメントポジションへステップアップ  【職場環境】  ・リモートワーク：週半分以上可能  ・入社3ヶ月程度は出社メイン、それ以降はリモートワーク移行可能  （部門の方針で週40％以上の出社が推奨となっております） title: [쿠팡이츠서비스] Business Automation Program Manager (Business & Operations)
description: 회사 소개   쿠팡이츠서비스(Coupang Eats Services)는 Delivery service에 대한 차별화 전략을 세우고, 쿠팡이츠의 고객, 상점주, 그리고 배달파트너들에게 한층 더 강화된 서비스와 지원을 제공하고 있습니다. 쿠팡이츠서비스는 원하는 음식을 언제 어디서든 빠르고 안전하게 배달함으로써 고객에게 놀라운 고객 경험을 선사하고, 상점주에게는 주문부터 배달, 고객응대까지 제공하는 원스톱 서비스를 통해 안정적인 판매 기회를 확보할수 있는 시스템을 운영하고 있습니다. 여러 분야의 전문가로 구성된 쿠팡이츠서비스는 하나의 팀으로서 고객과 상점주, 배달파트너가 원하는 가치를 고민하고 연구하며, 새로운 혁신과 패러다임 변화를 이끌어가고 있습니다.      업무내용    쿠팡이츠 배달 서비스 전반의 Customer Experience(CX) 품질을 실시간으로 모니터링하고, 고객 경험에 영향을 미치는 이슈를 조기에 감지·대응할 수 있는 운영 체계를 구축합니다.  주문 퍼널(App 진입 → 검색 → 장바구니 → 결제 → 주문 완료) 전반의 핵심 지표를 관리하며, 이상 징후를 탐지하기 위한 모니터링 프레임워크 및 Detection Logic을 설계합니다.  인시던트 발생 시 SOP(Standard Operating Procedure) 준수 여부를 모니터링하고, 표준화된 대응 프로세스를 고도화합니다.  SOP가 정의되지 않은 신규 이슈 발생 시 Strategy, Product, Engineering, Operations, Merchant 등 주요 Stakeholder 및 Leadership Team과 협업하여 대응 체계를 수립하고 신속하게 에스컬레이션합니다.  자동 Alert 시스템, 운영 대시보드(Control Panel), 비즈니스 자동화 솔루션을 기획 및 구축하여 운영 효율성과 문제 탐지 정확도를 향상시킵니다.  실시간 데이터 기반으로 서비스 이상 징후를 분석하고, 전사 영향도 및 Root Cause를 파악하여 개선 과제를 도출합니다.  고객 경험 개선, 비용 효율화(Cost Efficiency), 고객 리텐션 향상을 위한 운영 전략 및 서비스 로드맵을 수립합니다.  AI 기반 운영 도구 및 Workflow Automation을 활용하여 운영 프로세스를 지속적으로 개선하고 확장합니다.  VP 및 Director 레벨을 포함한 전사 리더십과 협업하며 주요 운영 지표, 인시던트, 프로젝트 성과를 공유하고 의사결정을 지원합니다.  한국 및 일본 시장을 포함한 글로벌 운영 환경에서 Cross-functional 프로젝트를 리딩합니다.       자격 요건    총 10년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분  Program Management, Product Management, Business Operations, Strategy, Process Improvement, Service Operations 분야 중 하나 이상의 경험을 보유하신 분  데이터 기반으로 문제를 정의하고 해결 방안을 도출한 경험이 있는 분  서비스 모니터링 체계, 운영 프로세스 또는 Incident Management 프로세스를 구축하거나 개선한 경험이 있는 분  다양한 이해관계자(Product, Engineering, Strategy, Operations 등)와 협업하며 프로젝트를 성공적으로 리드한 경험이 있는 분  복잡한 문제를 구조화하고 우선순위를 설정하여 실행할 수 있는 역량을 보유하신 분  Senior Leadership(VP, Director급) 대상 커뮤니케이션 및 의사결정 지원 경험이 있는 분  비즈니스 수준의 영어 커뮤니케이션이 가능한 분       우대 사항    배달, 커머스, 모빌리티, 플랫폼 서비스 등 대규모 운영 환경에서의 경험을 보유하신 분  Customer Experience(CX) 개선 또는 Customer Journey Optimization 경험이 있는 분  Incident Management, Emergency Response Team(ERT), Site Reliability, Service Operations 관련 경험이 있는 분  KPI 모니터링, 이상 징후 탐지, Alerting System 구축 경험이 있는 분  SQL, Python 등을 활용한 데이터 분석 경험을 보유하신 분  Airflow, Workflow Automation, API 연동, ETL Pipeline 등 비즈니스 자동화 구축 경험이 있는 분  Tableau, Looker, Power BI 등 Dashboard 및 Monitoring System 구축 경험이 있는 분  AI 기반 운영 자동화 또는 AI Tool 활용 경험이 있는 분  일본어 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 높은 수준의 Ownership을 가지고 문제를 해결한 경험이 있는 분       근무지    선릉 HJ 타워       전형 절차 및 안내 사항     전형절차 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 화상면접 – 최종 합격  전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.  전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

title: Operations Manager
description: About The Opportunity     Join a stable and well-established organisation in a hands-on Operations Manager role, taking ownership of day-to-day operations across a large-scale, high-volume environment.  Lead a team of supervisors and operational staff, with responsibility for performance, service delivery, people management and daily operational requirements.  Oversee fleet availability and allocation, working closely with internal maintenance and support teams to ensure resources are available and operational requirements are met.  Monitor operational KPIs and performance data, identifying trends, implementing improvements and ensuring service, safety and compliance targets are consistently achieved.  Manage real-time operational challenges, from staffing and scheduling through to incidents, customer queries and unexpected changes, ensuring issues are resolved quickly and effectively.     What You’ll Bring      Proven experience in operations, logistics, fleet management or another high-volume operational environment, with experience leading people and managing day-to-day service delivery.  Strong leadership skills, with the confidence to manage performance, make decisions and take control in a fast-paced environment.  A highly organised and process-driven approach, with the ability to plan, prioritise competing demands and keep operations running smoothly.  Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with confidence interpreting KPIs, identifying trends and using data to drive improved operational outcomes.  Resilience and composure under pressure, combined with a hands-on approach and the ability to communicate effectively with a broad range of stakeholders.     What’s on Offer     A genuine opportunity to take ownership of a significant operational environment and make a tangible impact on performance.  A broad leadership role combining people management, fleet coordination, KPI management, process improvement and daily operational decision-making.  A stable organisation with long-term operational commitments and a strong focus on service delivery.  Genuine career progression opportunities for a high-performing leader, with a focus on developing internal talent and future leadership capability.     Next Steps? For any questions give Henry Shaw a call on 027 326 7484 and quote Job ID: 18508for a confidential chat.  To apply for this vacancy, you MUST be a New Zealand citizen, resident, or have already secured the right to work in New Zealand and therefore hold a valid visa.  At the appropriate stage we will request your references, we ask that you do not include them on your CV when applying. title: Senior IT Project
description: NEVERHACK  ( https://neverhack.com/it ) è un gruppo francese specializzato in cybersecurity.  Fondato nel 2021 e con sedi in 11 paesi, il gruppo conta oggi più di 1200 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.  Siamo alla ricerca di un  Senior IT Project / Service Manager  con esperienza nella gestione end-to-end di progetti IT complessi e servizi continuativi per clienti enterprise e Pubblica Amministrazione. La figura sarà responsabile del governo operativo di commesse, milestone, budget, rischi, SLA e relazione con il cliente.      Responsabilità principali    Pianificazione, coordinamento e controllo di progetti IT complessi.  Gestione di SAL, milestone, deliverable, budget e avanzamento economico.  Presidio degli SLA contrattuali e della qualità del servizio erogato.  Coordinamento di team tecnici, fornitori e stakeholder di progetto.  Gestione dei rischi, delle criticità e dei piani di mitigazione.  Produzione di reportistica direzionale e comunicazioni verso il cliente.       Competenze tecniche    Project Management, Service Management e governance IT.  Framework ITIL e metodologie Agile/Waterfall.  Gestione contratti, SLA, OLA, budget e consuntivazione.  Strumenti di project tracking, ticketing e reporting.  Conoscenza di infrastrutture, applicazioni e servizi ICT enterprise.       Competenze trasversali    Leadership operativa e capacità di coordinamento.  Forte orientamento al cliente e alla delivery.  Capacità di gestire pressione, priorità e situazioni critiche.  Comunicazione chiara con interlocutori tecnici e manageriali.       Cosa offriamo    Inserimento in un team giovane e motivato, con percorsi strutturati di formazione e crescita.  Ambiente stimolante in ambito cybersecurity e IT, con possibilità di sviluppo su progetti complessi.  Modalità di lavoro remoto  RAL compresa tra   50.000–70.000k   commisurata all'esperienza      Sede di lavoro: Italia  Il processo di selezione prevede colloquio HR e 2 colloqui di carattere tecnico.

title: アルムナイ専門SaaS×コンサル｜カスタマーサクセス／コンサルタント
description: ▍募集背景   アルムナイ専門サービス「オフィシャル・アルムナイ」を通じて、企業とアルムナイを繋ぐネットワークを構築し、そこから生まれる価値創出に伴走するカスタマーサクセス/コンサルタントを、事業拡大に伴い募集いたします。      ▍ハッカズークが創る、新しいHRの未来     「退職で終わらない、企業と個人の新しい関係を実現し、退職による“損失”のない社会をつくる」    私たちは、日本における「企業アルムナイ（退職者）」領域のパイオニアとして、国内No.1の専用SaaS『Official-Alumni.com』とコンサルティングサービスを提供しています。各業界のリーディングカンパニーが私たちのパートナーです。  2026年からは、採用業務支援のレイン社との合併を経て、企業の人的資本経営を包括支援する「BBB（Buy＝採用、Build＝育成、Borrow＝外部人材活用）のプラットフォームになる」という新Visionを掲げ、加速度的な成長を推進しています。      ▍なぜ今「アルムナイ」が最高に面白いのか？     ｜「日本の人事史に名を刻む」歴史の転換点に、当事者として立ち会う    長年、日本の雇用慣行において退職者は「裏切り者」と見なされ、関係が断絶されるのが一般的でした。しかし、深刻な労働人口減少とキャリアの多様化、および人的資本経営の潮流により、退職者は「重要な社外のパートナー（資産）」へと再定義されつつあります。「退職＝損失」というこれまでの当たり前を根本から覆し、「別れを資産に変える」という新たな社会常識を日本中にインストールする——このパラダイムシフトの最前線を走るのが、ハッカズークです。       ｜「採用」の枠を遥かに超える、無限の市場性と本質的な価値    アルムナイネットワークがもたらす価値は、単なる「出戻り採用（Buy）」にとどまりません。業務委託（Borrow）としてのプロフェッショナル協業、新規事業のビジネスアライアンス、人材育成（Build）としてのアルムナイメンターや社外講師、それらの先に自社ブランドのファン・ユーザー化など、その可能性は無限です。  私たちが切り拓いているアルムナイ市場は、従来のHR（人材紹介や求人広告などの単発スポット取引）とは一線を画す、企業と個人が対等に、ライフタイムで価値を創出し続ける「新しいHRインフラ」です。だからこそ、提案の幅に制限はありません。     ｜   正解がないブルーオーシャンで、自ら「勝ち筋」を定義する    アルムナイ市場には、他社を模倣できるような既成の「コンサルティングの型」がありません。日本を代表するエンタープライズ企業の経営層や人事部長と対等に向き合い、「この企業とアルムナイの最適なリレーションとは何か」をゼロベースで共に描き、実行します。  自身がクライアントと創り出した企画がメディアに大きく取り上げられ、そのまま日本の新しい常識になっていく。パイオニアであるハッカズークだからこそ、唯一無二のダイナミックな経験を積むことができます。      ▍具体的な業務内容/ミッション   クライアント（主に大手エンタープライズ企業の人事部門や経営層）と伴走し、アルムナイネットワークを活用した企画立案・プロジェクト推進をお任せします。  すでに決まった制度設計の枠組みを当てはめるのではなく、ゼロベースでお客さまと一緒に「アルムナイと企業の新しい関係」を創り出していくポジションです。     ｜具体的な業務    アルムナイ施策の戦略・戦術設計および実行支援    ミッションは、顧客企業が目指すべき「あるべき姿」を共に描き、その実現に向けて価値を広げていくためのパートナーとして伴走することです。主に、以下を想定しております。  ・アルムナイの取り組みの目的の整理やKPI/KGIの設定  ・現状の課題分析やアルムナイネットワークによる成果創出に向けた施策の提案  ・ユーザー（アルムナイ）分析/ヒアリングをもとにした改善案の提案       アルムナイコミュニティの立ち上げ・運用    「すべての人（アルムナイ）にとって、居る理由がある場所をつくる」という想いのもと、アルムナイとの関係性を構築しながらコミュニティ運営をしていくことが、私たちのミッションです。  ・ユーザー（アルムナイ）へのインタビュー  ・コンテンツ作成チームと連携したアルムナイ向け配信コンテンツ企画  ・イベント運営チームと連携した交流会やアルムナイ向けイベントの企画     その他、個社の目的別にカスタマイズした施策の提案を行なっています。新しい領域かつ答えがないため、「これをやったら必ず上手く行く」というシンプルなものではありません。そこが難しくもあり、面白いところでもあります。単なる運用コンサルティングに留まらず、ネットワークの新たな価値を創るため顧客最適で提案をカスタマイズしていけることが醍醐味です。  また、このフェーズだからこそ、手を挙げれば誰でも、クライアント支援にとどまらず、プロダクトや事業づくり、サービス開発にも関わることができます。スタートアップならではの環境をご自身のオンリーワンのキャリア形成に活用したい方、大歓迎です。      ▍ポジションの魅力   コンサルタントの介在価値が非常に高く、自らが手掛けた企画が社会的なニュースとして取り上げられるなど、世の中に大きなインパクトを与えることができます。決まった成功体験（勝ち筋）をなぞるのではなく、あなた自身のアイデアで成功事例を創り出せる環境です。     事例1：「アルムナイメンター制度」  アルムナイネットワークにいる人材を活用し、キャリア自律の観点から退職者を巻き込んだメンター制度の構築を支援。日経新聞に大きく取り上げられました。  実際の記事はこちら     事例2：「カムバックイベント」企画  結婚や出産で退職された女性社員の方々に向けた、お子さん連れOKのカムバックイベントを企画・実施。こちらもメディアの密着取材が入るなど、大きな反響を呼んでいます。  実際の記事はこちら      ▍対象となる方   ｜必須要件  以下2つのご経験を”いずれも”お持ちの方  ・法人に対するソリューション型の営業経験（提案営業経験）  ・提案したことを形にするための、課題解決に向けたプロジェクトの推進・ディレクション経験（社内外のステークホルダーを巻き込んだ経験）  ※人事・HR業界の経験や、人事コンサルティングの経験は【不問】です！     ｜歓迎要件  ・大手企業（エンタープライズ領域）に対するアカウントマネジメント経験  ・無形商材を用いた企画提案の経験  ・イベント企画やコンテンツ制作などのディレクション経験     ｜求める人物像  ・既成の枠組み（決まったコンサル手法）を当てはめるだけでなく、ゼロベースで自ら考えることができる方  ・クライアントの成功に向けて、枠に囚われず「なんでもやる」スタンスを持てる方  ・IPOを目指す過渡期のフェーズにおいて、整っていない環境（カオス）を楽しみ、自ら道を作っていける方      ▍諸条件   詳細はこちら

title: Commissioning Manager

description: Company Description  Data-Centric Engineering Sdn Bhd is a Malaysia-based engineering company focused on delivering high-quality, data-driven solutions for industrial and infrastructure projects. The organization emphasizes the integration of engineering expertise with advanced analytics to improve performance, reliability, and safety. Team members collaborate closely with clients and partners to design, implement, and optimize technical systems that meet strict regulatory and operational standards. Role Description  The Commissioning Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in the Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. This role is responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing commissioning activities for engineering projects, from pre-commissioning to final handover. Day-to-day tasks include developing commissioning plans, procedures, and schedules; supervising site commissioning teams; conducting functional and performance tests; and ensuring that all systems are installed and operating according to design specifications, safety regulations, and client requirements. Sound knowledge of relevant industry standards, safety regulations, and quality assurance practices applicable to commissioning and start-up.  Excellent project coordination and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work with multidisciplinary teams and external contractors. Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal); proficiency in Bahasa Malaysia is an advantage.  Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, or related discipline) or equivalent professional experience. Willingness to work on-site, adhere to safety requirements, and occasionally travel to project locations if required.

title: Principal, Renewal Operations & Strategy
description: Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,200 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 15 million employees. description:

 We are B2Spin, and we are dedicated to delivering the best Free-to-Play Social Casino and gaming experiences by creating captivating, engaging, and unique products that are accessible to everyone. We have built a team of talented professionals from all over the globe, who are working to continually improve the experiences of our players. We are not looking to just be part of the industry, but to revolutionize it.     The Role   We run the creative function for retention at a multi-brand iGaming company. That means high-volume, high-frequency output — emails, push notifications, in-app messages, onsite banners — produced for segmented player audiences across multiple brands, all at the same time. This is a marketing creative leadership role, not a product or UX design role. You will lead a team of Digital Designers producing retention marketing assets across four brands and multiple CRM channels — not app or product interfaces.  The Design Team Lead owns the quality and consistency of that output. Not by reviewing everything personally, but by building the systems, standards, and team capability that make good work the default. This is as much an ops-and-systems role as it is a creative leadership role. If you're energized by turning "we eyeball it every time" into "we have a standard for that," this is the job.         What You Will Own    Brand systems that actually get used   Our brands are fragmented today. You'll build the documented visual systems — templates, component libraries, per-brand rules, practical "do this, not that" guidance — that designers reach for rather than work around. When the system is good, consistency stops being something we police and becomes the default.     Repeatable production at scale   Multiple designers producing work across four brands and CRM channels need modular templates, clear briefing standards, and clean versioning. You'll build and maintain those foundations. Just as importantly, you'll convert the feedback you keep repeating into checklists and onboarding material — so nobody gives the same note twice.     AI that produces on-brand results, not surprises   We already use AI heavily; the results aren't predictable enough. You'll put structure around it: per-brand prompt libraries, locked reference styles, clear review checkpoints, and training on how to take a raw AI output and finish it to a genuinely on-brand standard.     Quality that can be measured   You'll define what "on-brand and high quality" means for each brand, track simple signals like first-pass approval rate and rework volume, and catch delivery or quality risks before they hit send dates. You'll also keep improving how the team works — processes, tools, handovers — without waiting to be asked.     A team that feels clear and supported   Regular 1:1s, honest consistent feedback, and being the person designers come to when they're stuck. You'll monitor workload

Dein Purpose:

Ohne dich treffen wir Entscheidungen im Bauchgefühl. Mit dir bei entstehen ein Zahlenfundament und eine Perspektive, die beides können: erklären, was war und aufzeigen, was möglich ist. Du hast in der Vergangenheit nicht nur mit Daten gearbeitet, sondern bereits Strukturen aufgebaut, Prozesse etabliert und einen BI-Bereich wirklich geprägt? Dann bring deinen Erfahrungsschatz bei uns ein!

Für diese Themen brennst du:

Den Wald sehen, nicht nur die Bäume.

Du liebst es, Zusammenhänge zu erkennen, die andere übersehen. Komplexe Datenlagen schrecken dich nicht ab – du machst sie navigierbar und verständlich. Gleichzeitig weißt du, welche strategisch relevant sind und welche nicht.

Aus wenig viel machen.

Perfekte Datenlage? Die gibt es selten. Du weißt, wie du mit dem arbeitest, was da ist, machst Annahmen transparent und sprichst dennoch klaren Handlungsempfehlungen aus.

Übersetzen statt berichten.

Zahlen allein verändern nichts. Du bringst sie zum Sprechen und schaffst eine Basis für fundierte Entscheidungen. Du hast ein gutes Gespür, welche Daten Geschäftsführung, Finanzen und Product Management brauchen und weißt genau, wie du Komplexität so aufbereitest, dass sie Entscheidungen beschleunigt statt verzögert.

Gestalten, nicht warten.

Du siehst, was fehlt, und fängst an - ohne vollständige Roadmap, ohne perfekte Grundlage. Du hast bereits in einem anderen Kontext BI Strukturen aufgebaut und weißt wo die Fallstricke liegen – dieses Wissen möchtest du bei uns einbringen.

So bringst du deine Skills ein:

  • Dich erwartet eine grüne Wiese: Du baust den BI-Bereich auf – Strukturen, Prozesse, Tooling – und entwickelst ihn iterativ weiter

title: Pulverbeschichter, Oberfächenbeschichter, Lakierer
description:
Unser Kunden ein privat geführtes Unternehmen der Oberflächentechnologie (Galvanisch Verzinken, Feuerverzinken, Nasslack) Hat ein neues Werk für die Pulverbeschichtung errichtet. Das Besondere: hier werden 3-dimensionale Teile bis zu 9 Metern Pulverbeschichtet! Das Werk liegt an der Deutschen Grenze in Österreich. Passau, München und der Kurort Bad Füssing sind in erreichbarer Nähe.

Aufgaben

• Selbstständiges Pulverbeschichten von Metallbauteilen nach Qualitätsvorgaben

• Einstellen und Bedienen der Pulverpistolen bzw. Beschichtungsanlagen

• Vorbereitung, Sichtkontrolle und Beurteilung der zu beschichtenden Bauteile

• Kontrolle der Beschichtungsqualität und Erkennen typischer Beschichtungsfehler

• Durchführung von Farb- und Pulverwechseln sowie sorgfältiger Umgang mit Material und Anlagen

• Einhaltung der internen Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Arbeitsvorgaben

Qualifikation

• Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Pulverbeschichtung ist ideal

• Alternativ: Ausbildung oder fundierte Berufserfahrung als Industrie-, Fahrzeug- oder Lackiertechniker

• Gutes handwerkliches Geschick, saubere und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise

• Technisches Verständnis und selbstständiges Arbeiten

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse für die sichere Kommunikation im Produktionsumfeld

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im 2-Schicht-Betrieb

Benefits

Auch sehr gute Industrie- oder Fahrzeuglackierer ohne bisherige Erfahrung in der Pulverbeschichtung sind für uns interessant. Bei passender praktischer Erfahrung und handwerklichem Geschick übernehmen wir die gezielte Einschulung in die Pulverbeschichtung.

Mein Unternehmen vermittelt seit 25 Jahren Fach- und Führungskräfte speziell aus dem Bereich der Oberflächentechnologie (Galvanik, Lack-, Pulver-, KTL Beschichtungen, Feuerverzinkung). Wir sind im D-A-CH Gebiet tätig.

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. Now we need a PM who wants to take that further, in a market being rewritten in real time.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. Nobody has really figured out what reliability means for this kind of software yet. That's the problem you'd own.

Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!


Funny name, serious business

We are a leading eco-friendly household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we’ve contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we’re really good at making it easy to do good.

We operate scaling businesses in the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our amazing team is based in Australia, the UK, the Philippines, China, and the US, with our 250+ people aiming to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.


A bit about the role

As our Director of Acquisition Marketing, you’ll own our global acquisition strategy and performance, sitting at the intersection of data, performance and creativity. You’ll bring deep performance marketing expertise, strong commercial judgement and a rigorous approach to measurement and experimentation to drive sustainable, profitable new customer growth.

This is a full-funnel acquisition role, connecting brand, media and creative to understand what drives performance and turn those insights into stronger acquisition outcomes. While DTC acquisition is the immediate focus, you’ll also think beyond individual channels and optimise acquisition investment for the best incremental business impact across DTC, Amazon and retail.

You’ll be the person who connects the dots between performance data, marketing effectiveness and action — working in partnership with our Marketing Analytics team to turn incrementality, MMM and experimentation insights into better decisions across channels, tactics and campaigns. You’ll also lead and develop our Acquisition Marketing team, building the capability, systems and ways of working to scale our growth engine globally. The role reports to our GM of Growth Marketing and is a remote, Australia-based position.

If you worked here this past month, here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Reviewed channel, audience and campaign performance and reallocated budgets across tactics to improve new-customer acquisition efficiency and commercial returns.
  • Partnered with the Marketing Analytics team to drive incrementality testing, interpret MMM outputs and apply experimentation learnings, using the results to change channel, tactic and campaign strategy.
  • Worked with creative and local teams to identify the creative concepts, formats and messages driving acquisition performance, then scaled winning appr

title: Marketing Data Scientist
description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Why this role matters:

We are looking for a Data Scientist to own our demand and revenue intelligence capabilities. You will sit at the intersection of marketing strategy and commercial outcomes, building the predictive models and analytical frameworks that tell us where growth is coming from before it arrives. Your work will directly shape how we reach the right audiences, invest in the right channels, and accelerate pipeline - turning marketing activity into a measurable, forward-looking revenue engine.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Analyze and model the relationship between marketing investment, channel performance, and revenue outcomes, connecting spend to growth
  • Design and maintain reporting views and self-serve analytics assets for internal stakeholders and marketing partners; making model outputs and performance data accessible, consistent, and actionable across teams
  • Identify high-value market segments and audiences through data modeling to inform how and where we compete
  • Develop personalization models and frameworks that enable tailored customer experiences across channels, from dynamic content and offers to next-best-action recommendations
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Sales teams to define forecasting methodologies and embed models into operational workflows
  • Translate complex model outputs into clear, actionable narratives that drive strategic decisions at the executive level
  • Contribute to the development of AI-ready data structures in Snowflake, including clean feature tables, scoring outputs, and audience segments that serve as reliable inputs for marketing automation and AI-driven decisioning

What you'll bring:

  • Strong understanding of the full B2B revenue funnel - from awareness and demand generation through pipeline to closed revenue - and how data flows across it
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect predictive model outputs to strategic marketing and revenue decisions
  • The ability to influence RevOps, Sales, and Marketing stakeholders through data-led storytelling
  • A rigorous yet pragmatic approach to forecasting - knowing when to build a sophisticated model and when a well-structured regression is enough
  • A proven self-starter comfortable operating in fast-moving, commercially-driven environments
  • A working fluency with AI tools and LLM-based workflows — able to leverage AI to accelerate analysis, prototype models, and operate effectively in an AI-first data environment

Required:

  • 8 years of experience in Data Science, Revenue Analytics

title: Strategic Business Development Consultant
description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Vonage Communications APIs

As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure — reaching and engaging customers on their preferred schedule and channel, including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more.

Why this role matters

Operating at the intersection of market sensing, partnerships, and solution incubation, you'll ensure NwPS solutions are built in alignment with customer demand and ahead of competitive shifts — with a focus on opportunity creation that converts into revenue over a 12–36 month horizon.

Your key responsibilities

Market & Opportunity Discovery

  • Identify emerging market needs, industry inflection points, and new monetisation models aligned with corporate strategy

  • Develop and validate new use cases, vertical plays, and solution concepts that can scale over time

  • Conduct structured market analysis (TAM, value pools, buying centres, competitive dynamics)

Pipeline Incubation

  • Build and maintain a future-year opportunity pipeline (12–36 months) with clear conversion paths into sales execution

  • Seed early-stage opportunities through pilots, design partnerships, and proofs of value

  • Work with Sales Overlay and core sales teams to transition mature opportunities into active sales motions

Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Development

  • Structure joint value propositions, co-innovation initiatives, and go-to-market frameworks

  • Support partnership governance, alignment, and long-term growth planning

Solution Incubation & Executive Engagement

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Architecture teams to validate feasibility, differentiation, and scalability of new concepts

title: Senior Product Manager, AI and Endpoint
description:
About Teramind

Teramind is a global leader in workforce intelligence, insider risk management, and data loss prevention. Used by thousands of companies across 60+ countries, our platform gives organizations the visibility to protect their people, their data, and their operations. We sit at the intersection of three converging markets - Insider Risk, DLP, and Workforce Analytics - and we are one of the few players that spans all three on a unified behavioral data layer.

The Teramind Endpoint Agent is one of the key differentiators of our platform. It runs on hundreds of thousands of endpoints across Windows, macOS, and Linux, capturing the behavioral signal that powers our detection, DLP enforcement, analytics, and AI. The depth and quality of what the Agent sees is a primary reason customers choose Teramind over the alternatives - and the product leader who owns it plays a pivotal role in the company's success.

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Teramind Endpoint Agent, and the AI Usage Control capabilities built on top of it, end to end. You will be the single accountable product leader for the roadmap, priorities, and outcomes of the Agent organization - approximately half of Teramind engineering, working across operating systems, low-level platform components, and the server-side telemetry pipeline. This is a pivotal role. The Agent is one of the strongest competitive moats Teramind has, and the next chapter of the product strategy depends on what we build into it. You are coming in to bring product rigor, customer insight, prioritization discipline, and technical judgment to a team that is capable of shipping world-class endpoint technology. AI Usage Control is one of the most important things you will build here. Companies have spent twenty years governing what employees do with sensitive data, and they now have a second workforce: AI agents reading files, calling tools, and executing commands on the same machines, with none of the accountability. Nobody has worked out what supervising them looks like, and much of it never touches the network, so the endpoint is the only place you can see it. You will own that end to end. You will sit alongside other product managers, reporting to the VP of Product. Together, you own Teramind's product surface area.

What You Will Own

  • The Agent roadmap across all platforms. Windows, macOS, Linux, and the platforms after them. You decide what ships, in what order, and why, balancing customer demand, platform modernization, performance, and security hardening on one prioritized backlog.
  • The endpoint layer of AI Usage Control. Detecting AI that never touches the network - native desktop clients, IDE-embedded assistants, terminal-based coding agents, AI-native Teramind | Senior Product Manager, AI and Endpoint browsers, and local model

title: Director of Engineering, Cloud & Reliability
description:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

We're hiring a Director of Engineering - Cloud & Reliability to lead our infrastructure transformation and establish industry leading reliability practices. This role will be instrumental in evolving Boulevard's infrastructure into a scalable, reliable, secure, and highly available platform that supports our rapid growth and customer needs across a spectrum of market segments (Small Business, Franchises, Enterprises).

Reporting to the SVP of Engineering, you'll lead a team of infrastructure and reliability engineers while driving the technical strategy for our cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, and platform capabilities. Your work will directly enable the Engineering & Data teams to deliver APIs, services, customer-facing products and data capabilities at scale by providing robust, self-service infrastructure foundations.

You'll architect and implement modern infrastructure practices including containerization, infrastructure-as-code, advanced CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability systems. This role is perfect for a technical leader who wants to build the infrastructure platform that becomes the backbone of Boulevard's next phase of growth.

Domains of Ownership

  • Cloud Infrastructure & Platform - Design, implement, and maintain scalable AWS infrastructure including multi-region deployments, and infrastructure-as-code

title: Mid-Market Customer Success Manager EMEA
description:

title: ServiceNow Alliance Executive
description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Vonage Sales Mission

At Vonage, we’re redefining how businesses communicate in today’s fast-moving digital, cloud, and real-time world. Our Sales team is high-energy, customer-focused, and relentlessly innovative - committed to delivering cutting-edge UCaaS, CCaaS, and AI-powered solutions.

The ServiceNow Alliances team is a key growth engine for Vonage—driving pipeline and revenue by aligning our business with ServiceNow and its extended ecosystem. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on relationship-building, strategic partnerships, and go-to-market execution.

  • A relationship-driven professional who thrives in a partner-centric ecosystem
  • Experienced in working with alliances, channel sales, or ecosystem partnerships

description:

We strive to innovate and enhance our customers’ ability to communicate within today’s digital, cloud and real-time business environments. Our team is composed of highly-motivated, energetic and customer-focused team Members that expand existing accounts/channels and find new clients to adopt our UCaaS and CCaaS products and services.

As part of Vonage’s Field Sales organization, Our Account Executives identifies and acquires new customers for the company’s robust, feature-rich residential and business communications solutions. We develop and execute sales strategies to address the needs of customers ranging from single-person companies to those with thousands of employees spread over multiple locations. title: Principal AI & Agent Systems Engineer (gn) @ Fusion Energy Venture, Munich
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

We are building a new path to fusion energy. Every major leap in human civilisation has followed a breakthrough in energy, from fire to steam to electricity, and we believe fusion is the next one. Our bet is that it will not come from building bigger machines. It will come from controlling matter with enough precision that fusion becomes a manufacturable technology, atoms aligned exactly enough that fusion happens under controlled conditions, on a chip. This is a semiconductor-scale path to clean power, and our stance is precision over brute force. We start in physics and simulation, then build the physical proof. 

About the Role

Reaching a chip-scale approach means working through physics and simulation at a depth that is hard to reach by conventional means, and to do that we need a new class of scientific intelligence. You will work directly with the founders to design that system from the ground up: an AI-driven research platform that can read papers, connect ideas across disciplines, orchestrate simulations, evaluate hypotheses and learn from results. This is not a chatbot or prompt engineering role, and we are not building a foundation model or competing with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google. We believe these systems will need richer representations than today's token-prediction models, so you will help explore new architectures for scientific reasoning, memory, hypothesis generation and autonomous discovery. The better that system works, the faster we get to the physical proof.

What you'll do

Ervaring als Customer Success Manager, Account Management of in een vergelijkbare rol binnen een B2B SaaS omgeving.  Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels. title: Customer Success Manager
description: About the Role   Userpilot gives product teams a fully customizable experience layer that sits on top of their UI, enabling them to deliver contextual, personalized flows triggered by user behavior, journey stage, and segment. It's a technically versatile platform, and making it work for a high volume of customers efficiently is the challenge this role is built around.
