title: Trust & Safety Lead (Technical) (f/m/d)
description:
Your mission

nebenan.de connects real neighbours under their real names. That only works if people feel safe here. Your mission is to keep our users safe: with technical safeguards built into our platform and API, with product features that help neighbours protect themselves, and in close partnership with our Community Management team.

You look at everything security first. You ask how someone could attack the trust of our users, and you prevent it before it happens. At the same time you think in products, not only in backend systems: a well-placed warning in the interface, a clear reporting flow, or a safer default setting often protects more people than another rule on the server.

Concretely, you will:

Build safety into the platform

  • Design and implement technical safeguards in our API and backend: abuse detection, rate limiting, verification checks, and the signals that catch fake accounts and scams early.
  • Ship user-facing safety features. Reporting flows, warnings on suspicious messages, blocking and privacy controls, safer defaults. Safety that users can see and use.
  • Threat-model new features before they ship. Ask how a bad actor would abuse them, and design the friction and detection against it.

Think security first

  • Stay current on how attacks on social platforms evolve: account takeover, fake accounts, romance and marketplace scams, phishing and QR lures, spam rings, coordinated harassment.
  • Lead the response when something is spreading or someone is at risk: decide, act, then close the route it came through.
  • Decide what we build ourselves and what we buy. Where the market already solves a problem, such as content scanning, evaluate it, buy it and integrate it. Build where the problem is specific to nebenan.

Work as one with Community Management

  • Our moderation team handles cases day to day.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
Muris is building the AI operating system for agricultural logistics, optimizing the process from field to factory. Our food supply chains are increasingly exposed to fluctuations, caused by factors such as weather, prices, and labor shortages. We are working to make our food supply chains more sustainable, resilient, and future-ready.

You are the first technical hire. Your job is to turn messy operations into a decidable problem and ship the result so that dispatchers actually use it. Everything in between is yours: data, model, system, interface.

What you do

  • Formalize dispatching problems: what is being decided, at what granularity, under which assumptions, against which objectives.
  • Choose the simplest model that carries the decision. Heuristic before solver, solver before learning.
  • Define the evaluation before you build. What would a better decision have been, and how would we know.
  • Ship end-to-end: from the data pipeline through the model to the interface the dispatcher looks at. A recommendation nobody understands doesn't count.
  • Sit at the plant and with the dispatchers to get rules that aren't in the data.

This is not for you if

  • you're looking for a narrowly scoped specialist role
  • you want to solve open research questions
  • you want to fit a given dataset instead of formulating the problem yourself
  • you're not willing to regularly visit factories

This is for you if

  • you've turned messy reality into a decision problem before (OR, dispatch, planning, pricing, allocation)
  • operators have used something you built
  • you're quantitatively strong and still prefer owning the whole over owning the method
  • you can explain models without hiding behind the method
  • you can work with incomplete data and hard constraints

We work in English.

TL;DR: We're hiring a Human Resources Business Partner to partner with Engineering, Product & Design (EPD) at Lovable - our largest and fastest-growing organization. You'll act as a trusted advisor to the leadership team, and fly at many different altitudes every day. You’ll advise on org design, location strategy, talent planning, employee relations, manager effectiveness, and change management as we scale across Stockholm and London.

This is an in-office role is based in Stockholm or London.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

 Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. title: Senior QA Engineer | London
description:
We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to establish and lead quality assurance across a large and growing web platform. This is a critical role responsible for introducing structure, consistency, and confidence into the release process.

Key Responsibilities:

Quality Assurance:

  • Define and implement QA processes and standards

  • Perform manual testing across multiple websites and applications

  • Own regression testing for releases, migrations, and new features

  • Act as the quality gate before production releases

Automation & Improvement:

  • Define and begin implementing a test automation strategy

  • Select tools and identify areas suitable for automation

  • Collaborate with developers and DevOps to improve quality practices

  • Mentor junior QA engineers as the team grows


Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of QA experience, primarily web-focused

  • Strong background in manual testing

  • Experience setting up QA processes from scratch

  • Familiarity with modern web stacks and CMS platforms

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

 

Nice to have:

  • Automation experience (Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, etc.)

  • Experience with accessibility or performance testing

  • Previous lead or senior QA role

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

description:
Persönlichkeit – Engagement – Innovation!​

In der AppFactory bei GRAYOAK entstehen innovative, cloud-agnostische Softwarelösungen für kritische Infrastrukturen und hochsensible Betriebsumgebungen. Unsere Anwendungen werden für den sicheren Einsatz in der Cloud, On-Premise sowie in Air-Gapped-Umgebungen entwickelt.
 
Informationssicherheit, Compliance, Datenhoheit und Resilienz sind dabei feste Bestandteile unserer Architektur- und Entwicklungsprozesse. In interdisziplinären Teams begleiten wir unsere Kunden von der Konzeption über die sichere Umsetzung bis zum zuverlässigen produktiven Betrieb.
 
Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf verlässlichen Build-, Test- und Release-Prozessen: Deployments werden automatisiert, saubere Pipelines etabliert und neue Versionen schnell, sicher und nachvollziehbar ausgeliefert. Die Rolle konzipiert Release- und Deployment-Architekturen, die sich flexibel an unterschiedliche Kundenumgebungen anpassen lassen, und fungiert als technischer Ansprechpartner für Entwicklungs- und Produktteams.

Almost slipping into a deep coma from the "We're looking for a highly experienced Customer Success Manager... blah blah blah" job adverts...  And you're looking for an exciting opportunity to join the fastest growing digital agency in the country...  Then this will be the most important job listing you ever read.  Firstly... stop what you're doing and watch this - https://youtu.be/OPdKs9NM380  Okay let's continue...  We are a full-service digital marketing agency that is growing FAST! And this is just one of the reasons we've been named as one of the BEST PLACES TO WORK in Australia & New Zealand by AFR and one of the Top 100 Coolest Companies in Australia by Anthill Magazine.  Look, the list goes on and on... because we've seriously won more awards than you can shake a stick at.  Now here's the thing.  Our Digital Growth Strategists are the people our clients call when it matters. They're sharp, they're hungry, and they carry a lot on their shoulders.  What they need is someone in their corner. Every single day.  Someone who's been in the trenches. Who's had the hard client conversation and come out the other side with the account intact. Who can look at a struggling campaign and know whether it's a strategy problem, a delivery problem, or a client-expectation problem - and knows exactly who to call for each one.  That's the role.  You'll sit between the Head of Digital Growth Strategy and the DGS team as their first point of contact, coach, and cover. Process questions, contract queries, billing curveballs, cranky clients at 4:55pm on a Friday - they come to you, and you have the authority to actually solve them. title: Klantteammanager Beveiligingssystemen
description: Mijn baan   Als Klantteammanager bij de organisatie Beveiligingssystemen (KBS) ben ik commercieel en operationeel eindverantwoordelijk voor de dienstverlening aan alle aan mij toegewezen strategische klanten. Dit doe ik in de basis voor de reguliere dienstverlening van KBS en daarnaast ook voor de aanvullende dienstverlening van heel de organisatie, waarbij ik de hieraan gekoppelde (account)teamleden functioneel aanstuur. Mijn doel is niet alleen om de overeengekomen doelstellingen te behalen binnen budget en afgesproken termijn, maar juist ook om klanten waar mogelijk positief te verrassen. Ik maak onderdeel uit van de serviceorganisatie en rapporteer aan de Landelijke Vestigingsleider Service, de eindverantwoordelijke voor de serviceorganisatie. Binnen mijn klantportefeuille zorg ik ervoor dat de meerjaren onderhoudsbudgetten, onderhoudsplanningen en onderhoudsrapportages op een heldere manier met het team en opdrachtgevers worden geborgd. Daarnaast verken ik bij mijn klanten waar projecten en mogelijk ook andere diensten van de organisatie gerealiseerd kunnen worden. Deze speel ik vervolgens intern door aan commerciële collega’s van andere afdelingen en entiteiten om op te pakken, waarbij ik altijd de primaire SPOC (Single Point of Contact) blijf richting de klant. Ik voeg dus accountteamleden toe om samen de klant optimaal te bedienen. Ik begrijp als geen ander dat een optimaal rendement alleen behaald wordt met een uitstekend functionerend accountteam. Daarom hecht ik veel waarde aan positieve aansturing en ben ik een benaderbare vraagbaak voor zowel het team als opdrachtgevers. Om toekomstbestendig te blijven denk ik binnen de organisatie graag medewerker én klanttevredenheid, heb ik mijn werk goed gedaan. ## Daarom pas ik bij de organisatie! We publish institutional-quality macro analysis every day across a video series, a weekly research letter, and live desk access, and we run a fast-growing subscription business with a large and engaged audience.  The Role    We're hiring a Head of Customer Success to own the entire customer experience after someone becomes part of Crown Macro: onboarding, product education, support, subscription and billing, feedback, retention, and recovery when something goes wrong.     This is a senior operating role, not a customer-service management position. You'll start hands-on, personally supporting customers, resolving issues, and learning where they succeed, where they struggle, and why they leave. From there you'll build the systems, processes, tooling, and team that let us deliver fast, thoughtful, high-quality support at scale.     The best support isn't just closing tickets. It's one of the strongest sources of product intelligence a company has. We want someone who can solve a customer's problem personally, find the systemic cause, work with product and engineering to eliminate it, and build the process that prevents the next hundred customers from hitting the same wall. Often the best support interaction is the one the customer never needs to have, because the underlying problem is gone.  What You'll Own     Support, end to end.  Own the support function and personally handle customer conversations in the early stage: account, billing, subscription, product, and access issues. Set clear standards for response time, resolution quality, tone, and escalation, and build escalation paths for technical problems, payment failures, account access, and complaints.      Systems that scale.  Select and continuously improve the tools for communication, ticketing, knowledge management, reporting, and automation. Build self-service resources — help docs, FAQs, account-management tools, contextual product guidance — so support scales without becoming impersonal or headcount-bound. Use automation and AI where they improve speed, and keep human judgment where it matters.      Support as product intelligence.  Work with product and engineering to reproduce bugs, prioritize recurring issues, and eliminate root causes. Serve as a consistent voice of the customer: capture, categorize, and route feedback to product, engineering, editorial, growth, and leadership, and separate one-off requests from patterns that warrant real change.      Onboarding and education.  Improve onboarding so new subscribers quickly understand the product and reach value early, and build education programs that help them get more from Crown Macro's research and tools.      Retention and churn.  Identify subscribers who are struggling or likely to cancel and intervene appropriately. Own cancellation and save flows with respect

title: Sales Engineer (Enterprise)
description:
About Halter.

At Halter, we're on a mission to enable farmers and producers to run the most productive and sustainable operations in the world. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the constraints of conventional practices, and revolutionising pasture farming with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry.

People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you'll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care.

The Role.

We're looking for an exceptional Sales Engineer to join Halter's Enterprise Sales team, partnering with the largest and most influential farming businesses across New Zealand and Australia.

This is not a traditional pre-sales engineering role. You'll become a trusted technical advisor to some of agriculture's most progressive organisations. You'll combine commercial awareness and technical expertise to solve complex operational challenges. Whether you're designing enterprise roll-out strategies, validating technical solutions, or influencing the future direction of our product, you'll play a critical role in helping our largest customers succeed.

You'll work alongside Enterprise Sales Managers and Key Account Managers throughout complex sales cycles, providing technical leadership from first engagement through to implementation planning.

You'll also become the voice of enterprise customers within Halter, ensuring the product continues to evolve to meet the needs of the world's leading farming businesses.

What your day could look like.

Enterprise Discovery & Solution Design

You'll work with Enterprise Sales Managers to deeply understand a customer's farming system, operational model and strategic priorities. You'll identify where Halter creates value, design technical solutions that meet complex enterprise requirements, and help customers envision what operating differently could look like across dozens of farms.

Technical Leadership

You'll become the technical expert in enterprise engagements, leading product demonstrations, solution workshops, technical discovery sessions and implementation planning. You'll confidently answer detailed questions around grazing systems, hardware, connectivity, integrations, data, reporting and large-scale deployments.

Customer Problem Solving

No two enterprise customers operate the same way. You'll enjoy unpacking complex operational challenges and collaborating with customers to develop practical solutions. You'll work with multiple stakeholders, from farm managers and operational leaders through to executives and boards, ensuring Halter can be successfully adopted across their organisation.

Product & Customer Feedback

Olet henkilö, jolla on syvä ymmärrys taloushallinnosta ja tilitoimistojen arjesta - ei teoreettinen, vaan käytännön kautta hankittu. Ymmärrät, mistä tilitoimiston liiketoiminta oikeasti muodostuu.  Lisäksi sinulle on luontevaa:    Rakentaa luottamuksellisia, pitkäkestoisia asiakassuhteita  Tunnistaa kasvumahdollisuuksia  Toimia muuttuvassa ympäristössä systemaattisesti     Miksi juuri tämä tehtävä?   Olet mukana kasvavan yhtiön ytimessä uuden konseptin rakentamisessa, et rivissä isojen rattaiden rattaana. Tiimi on pieni, päätökset tehdään nopeasti ja tekemäsi työ näkyy suoraan tuloksissa. Tarjoamme sinulle vahvan taustatuen, nykyaikaiset työkalut ja ympäristön, jossa saat keskittyä olennaiseen.  Tarjoamme myös kattavat henkilöstöedut, muun muassa laajan työterveyshuollon sekä lounas-, puhelin- ja virike-edut.  Tehtävän palkkahaitari on  4000 - 6000 € / kk , ja palkkaus määräytyy osaamisen ja aiemman kokemuksen mukaan.   Meillä arvostetaan   Easorilla työtä tehdään luottamuksen varassa. Saat vastuuta ja vapautta, mutta myös odotuksen siitä, että viet asioita eteenpäin oma-aloitteisesti. Tiimissä autetaan toisia ja jaetaan osaamista arjessa. Kehitämme tekemistä jatkuvasti yhdessä: kokeilemme, opimme ja parannamme suuntaa matkan varrella. Päätöksiä tehdään lähellä arkea, eikä asioita jätetä odottamaan.  Työtämme ohjaavat kolme arvoa:  Rohkeus – uskallamme kokeilla uutta, kyseenalaistaa ja tehdä asioita eri tavalla.   Draivi – viemme asioita eteenpäin määrätietoisesti ja otamme vastuuta tuloksista.   Välittäminen – pidämme huolta toisistamme, asiakkaistamme ja partnereistamme.  Toivomme, että nämä näkyvät myös tavassasi tehdä töitä.    Kiinnostuitko?    Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään  15.9.2026 . Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana.  Lisätiedot:  Maajohtaja Arne Hurm

title: Customer Care Manager (FR/EN)
description: Le contexte   Une marketplace B2B en forte croissance. D'un côté des grands comptes du retail et du e-commerce, de l'autre un réseau de 2000 acheteurs professionnels aux profils très variés.      Le service client a été construit de zéro ces derniers mois. Avant : pas d'outil, pas de process, un délai de réponse moyen de 70 heures. Aujourd'hui : tous les canaux sont centralisés, un chat développé en interne, moins de 2 heures de délai moyen. Le prochain palier, c'est de passer sous l'heure. C'est là que vous arrivez.      Le poste   Vous rejoignez une équipe Ops de 6 personnes, dont 2 dédiées au care acheteurs, épaulées par des alternants.  Le job est concret : environ 300 messages entrants par semaine (jusqu'à 500 en haute saison), à traiter, qualifier et transformer en tickets. Chat, réclamations, SAV, relances de paiement.  Environ 80% d'exécution opérationnelle, 20% de construction : ce que vous voyez passer en tickets alimente les chantiers d'amélioration (arborescence IA du chat, automatisations, documentation, process).      Vos missions    Traitement des demandes acheteurs    Répondre sur le chat et les autres canaux, en français et en anglais  Gérer les réclamations, le SAV, les relances de paiement  Suivre chaque dossier jusqu'à résolution  Tenir les délais de réponse, c'est l'indicateur numéro un    Gestion du ticketing    Transformer chaque demande en ticket qualifié et catégorisé  Surveiller les volumes, les délais, les tickets en attente  Repérer les récurrences    Suivi d'un portefeuille d'acheteurs    Comprendre leurs usages et leurs contraintes  Points réguliers, anticipation des difficultés  Prévenir le churn    Amélioration continue    Faire remonter les signaux faibles du ticketing en chantiers concrets  Coordonner avec la logistique, les opérations, la finance et les sales sur les cas complexes  Contribuer à la documentation (guides, FAQ, templates) et aux automatisations       La réalité du poste   Les stocks ne sont pas ceux de l'entreprise. Quand il y a un problème, il vient soit du vendeur (préparation, qualité), soit du transport, deux maillons partiellement externes. Le levier principal se joue donc sur la logistique et sur la qualité de la relation.  Autrement dit : c'est un poste où on résout des problèmes qu'on n'a pas créés. Il faut du sang-froid et un vrai goût pour le problem solving.      Le profil    2 à 3 ans en customer care ou customer success, en B2B  Anglais professionnel : indispensable, une partie des acheteurs est à l'international  À l'aise avec un outil de ticketing et avec la donnée basique  Bonne communication écrite et orale  Empathie naturelle, gestion des émotions solide  Esprit analytique, appétence pour proposer des solutions et monter des projets  Le diplôme compte moins que ce que vous avez déjà géré       Le process    Échange de qualification avec Sparkway  Entretien avec le Head of Operations  Business case  Rencontre avec le Codir

Du skal skabe tydelige rammer, retning og forventninger i hverdagen og sikre en god balance mellem kundernes behov, medarbejdernes trivsel og en effektiv drift i tæt samarbejde med de øvrige Kundeservicechefer. Du skal bidrage aktivt til at udvikle vores kundeservice og den måde som vi arbejder på.  Du bliver en del af en organisation i udvikling, hvor vi har store ambitioner for vores kundeservice. Derfor får du også mulighed for at sætte dit præg på både teamet og den fortsatte udvikling af AL Sydbank Direkte. Du indgår ligeledes i en ledergruppe, hvor dine lederkollegaer befinder sig i Aabenraa, Vejle, Herning, Slagelse og Sluseholmen.  Om dig  Vi forestiller os, at du er en synlig og engageret leder, som naturligt er tæt på både medarbejderne og driften. Du skaber følgeskab gennem tydelighed, tillid og nærvær, og du tør samtidig stille krav og følge op, når det er nødvendigt.  Det er vigtigt, at du:    har erfaring med personaleledelse – gerne fra kundeservice, bank eller en anden driftsorienteret organisation  motiveres af at udvikle mennesker og skabe resultater gennem andre  arbejder struktureret og har blik for både mennesker, kunder og performance  kan bruge data og nøgletal aktivt i din ledelse  kommunikerer tydeligt og skaber retning – også når hverdagen ændrer sig  tager ansvar og handler, når noget kræver opmærksomhed  ser samarbejde på tværs som en forudsætning for at lykkes.    Det vigtigste er, at du har energien og lysten til at gøre en forskel for både medarbejdere og kunder.  Om virksomheden  AL Sydbank er blandt Danmarks største banker med hovedsæde i Aabenraa. Vores mål er at skabe økonomisk tryghed og udvikling – for kunder, lokalsamfund og hinanden.  Hos os bliver du en del af et fællesskab med mere end 4.000 kolleger i Danmark og Nordtyskland. Vi tror på, at stærke relationer skaber de bedste resultater, og derfor bygger vi vores kultur på samarbejde, korte beslutningsveje, høj faglighed og et fælles fokus på at gøre tingene effektivt og ordentligt. title: Apulaismyymäläpäällikkö Vaasan myymäläämme
description: Etsimme Normal-myymäläämme iloisen ja energisen asenteen omaavaa apulaismyymäläpäällikköä!   Apulaismyymäläpäällikkönä olet avainasemassa luomassa asiakkaille uniikkia osto- ja asiakaskokemusta. Toimit myymäläpäällikön kanssa tiiminä, motivoiden ja kehittäen työntekijöitä avoimessa ja iloisessa ympäristössä. Yhdessä varmistatte, että myymälä toimii tehokkaasti ja saavuttaa myyntitavoitteet. Myymälän visuaalinen ilme ja tiimin johtaminen ovat intohimosi. Pääset perehtymään tehtävääsi huippuosaajien kanssa, jonka tavoitteena on antaa sinulle alkustartti ammatilliseen ja henkilökohtaiseen kasvuun ja kehittymiseen. Kenties mielenkiintosi on toimia jonakin päivänä NORMAL-ketjun myymäläpäällikkönä!  NORMAL on nuori dynaaminen yritys, joka on muutaman vuoden aikana avannut satoja myymälöitä ympäri Euroopan. Myös Suomessa kasvumme jatkuu edelleen.  Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme pysyvästi matalat hinnat ja useita tuhansia ”normaaleja” tuotteita mm. kemikalio-, kosmetiikka- ja kotitaloustuotteiden saralla, unohtamatta jännittäviä uutuuksia joka viikko useissa eri tuotekategorioissa. NORMAL on yritys, jossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia ja meillä on yhteiset menestymis- ja tulostavoitteet - ja samalla pidämme hauskaa yhdessä.   Mitä Toivomme Sinulta     olet kunnianhimoinen ja kerännyt kokemusta esihenkilönä toimimisesta - tuemme sinua roolissasi  asiakaspalvelu on intohimosi – asiakas on aina tärkein  olet motivoitunut, määrätietoinen ja väsymätön tiiminjohtaja – innostat ja motivoit omalla esimerkilläsi  paineensietokykyä – nopeatempoinen työ vie sinut mennessään ja uppoudut siihen mielelläsi  myymälän johtaminen ja kauppiashenkinen toiminen saa sinun syttymään – lukujen seuraaminen tukee myyntiä  omaat itsenäiset työskentelytaidot, mutta ymmärrät tiimin voiman – yhdessä on hauskempaa  sinulla on visuaalista silmää – esillepanojen teko best!  työt sijoittuvat niin aamu-, ilta- kuin välivuoroihinkin – monipuoliset työajat  kommunikoit vaivattomasti suomeksi ja asiakkaiden palvelu englanniksi onnistuu myös - but of course!  myymäläpäällikön ollessa poissa hyppäät puikkoihin empimättä ja varmistat myymäläntoiminnan     Mikäli etsit inspiroivaa, hauskaa ja menevää työpaikkaa, hae ihmeessä meille ja tule osaksi mahtavaa porukkaamme!  Maksamme palkkaa TES:in mukaisesti.   Oletko se sinä?   Odotamme innolla hakemustasi ja arvostamme myös videon muodossa tulevaa esittelyä! Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo ennen hakuajan umpeutumista, ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Come Key Account Manager, sarai responsabile dello sviluppo e della gestione delle relazioni strategiche con i clienti, promuovendo l'adozione di soluzioni basate su ricambi originali, negoziando accordi commerciali e individuando nuove opportunità di crescita del business. Sviluppare e mantenere partnership durature con i clienti chiave, garantendo elevati livelli di soddisfazione.  Negoziare e definire Service Level Agreement con i clienti a supporto della crescita del business post-vendita.  Negoziare accordi wholesale sui ricambi con i clienti che gestiscono proprie reti di officine e carrozzerie.  Supervisionare l'implementazione e la firma degli accordi commerciali e di servizio.  Monitorare le performance degli account e la crescita del business a seguito dell'implementazione degli accordi.  Rivedere, rinnovare e ottimizzare i Service Level Agreement in linea con gli obiettivi di business.  Preparare e mantenere aggiornati report di performance e analisi degli account. title: Customer Care Specialist
description: WHAT IS EDENRED?      Edenred is the global leader in Benefits & Engagement and Mobility. With more than 1 million client companies across 44 countries, Edenred's platform gives more than 60 million users access to the services and products of more than 2 million partner merchants.     Edenred offers digital solutions dedicated to employees (meal vouchers, commuting, gift cards, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers), fleet managers (multi-energy solutions including EV charging, maintenance services, tolls, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards).     Guided by the Group's purpose, "Enrich connections. For good.", these solutions enhance employees' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers. They promote access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. Finally, they improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses while vitalizing the employment market and local economies.     Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day. title: Sales Service Manager
description: Overview   Lutron is seeking a  Sales Service Manager  to drive service excellence and operational effectiveness across Japan. This role is responsible for leading all service-related functions and ensuring that service is a key differentiator in winning and growing business.  Supporting Lutron’s three core segments in Japan: Commercial, Hospitality, and Luxury Residential. This role partners closely with the sales organization to enhance customer experience, strengthen Lutron’s reputation, and ensure seamless execution across the project lifecycle.  The Sales Services Leader owns the performance, alignment, and continuous improvement of all service functions, while enabling the sales team to stay focused on growth.      Responsibilities    Lead all service functions to deliver consistent operational excellence  Drive high-quality service execution across all project segments  Partner with sales to enable focus on core business growth  Own cross-functional issue resolution and process improvement  Build and nurture strong customer and partner relationships  Lead, develop, and mentor the Japan service team  Oversee end-to-end service performance and continuous improvement  Deliver exceptional customer experience and satisfaction  Manage service operations and project lifecycle support  Champion service as a key market differentiator  Align service delivery with global quality standards       Qualifications    Bachelor’s degree required  10+ years of professional experience in service, operations, or a related function  Experience leading and developing teams  Fluency in both Japanese and English  Experience in construction, infrastructure, or project‑based environments is preferred      Lutron Electronics’ position as the worldwide leader in innovative lighting control and shading solutions has enabled consistent, annual growth. Make a difference every day in our dynamic, people-centric, technology-driven organization. For more information, view our website at www.lutron.com. Acompañar al equipo para asegurar criterios homogéneos y una atención de calidad.  Detectar incidencias recurrentes y convertirlas en mejoras de proceso.  Trabajar con herramientas de atención al cliente, ticketing y reporting operativo.  Colaborar con equipos internos para mejorar procesos, comunicación y experiencia de cliente.  Contribuir a construir una operación más estructurada, trazable y preparada para escalar. title: Client Manager
description: Company Description    Publicis Groupe is one of the largest communications groups in the world. We are building the agency model of the future and take a holistic approach to our clients’ challenges. By fusing together our media, creative, data and technology expertise, we are able to provide clients with integrated solutions, transformative ideas and compelling consumer experiences. We call it the Power of One.  We are proud winner of many awards and nominations, both in Sweden and internationally. But nothing makes us prouder than to work with clients and brands such as P&G, Disney, H&M, Mondelez, Volvo, VISA, Lantmännen, LEGO, Spotify, Perrigo, TUI and many more.  At Publicis, we put our people first. We are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work® for five consecutive years (2022–2026) and have won the Diversity Charter Sweden Awards in the category Mental Health (2025). We have also been recognized with a Magnet Award for our engaging culture (2023). Our goal is to become the leading workplace in our industry. We are based in two fantastic offices in Vasastan (Odengatan and Upplandsgatan) and offer a flexible work policy.    Overview   As a Client Manager you are overall responsible for your clients’ campaign work, all the way from media recommendations and planning to execution, including budget allocation cross channel where you lead and work closely with channel specialists in the client team.  As Client Manager you are also responsible for managing digital activations from start to finish. Including planning and buying, develop data-driven recommendations across all channels and continuously analyze and evaluate campaign results and support your clients with actionable recommendations. title: Operations Lead
description: Hurtiglading er en av de raskest voksende bransjene i Europa, og Norge ligger fremst i verden med sin elbilpark. Det betyr at standarden for hvordan hurtiglading skal fungere settes her og nå. Du får personalansvar for driftsteamet, og du får være med å forme det.     Vi jobber datadrevet og automatiserer det som kan automatiseres. Vi tar sikte på å oppdage utbedringer lenge før kundene gjør det, og streber etter å forutse fremfor å være reaktive. Teknologi, AI og automatisering er sentrale aspekter ved rollen, og du vil jobbe tett med produkt og teknologi for å innføre det som behøves for å gi teamet og Kople best mulig utgangspunkt for å levere.     Rollen eier resultatet i økte suksessrater, ikke kun et sett med arbeidsoppgaver. Du vil ha et sterkt team for å drive forbedringer og støtte fra ledergruppen til å prioritere det viktigste. Kople er stolte av et godt arbeidsmiljø, korte beslutningsveier, og godt samarbeid på tvers av alle teams.       Hva du kommer til å gjøre    Eie ladesuksessraten for hele porteføljen  Grave i data og innsikt til du finner rotårsaker, du løser også prioriterte saker selv med en praktisk tilnærming  Holde leverandører ansvarlig for hva som har blitt lovet. Du aksepterer ikke at en sak lukkes uten teknisk begrunnelse, og du eskalerer med logger, mønstre og avtaler i hånden  Aktivt lete etter måter å forbedre nettverket på, uten å vente på at feil meldes inn  Sette kravene for hva som skal være verifisert på software- og hardwaresiden før noe nytt innføres  Jobbe veldig tett med produktteamet på verktøy og automatisering som løfter suksessraten  Bygge et driftsteam med tydelig eierskap og høy fart       Hva vi måler    Reell suksessrate på porteføljen  Tid fra feilmelding til utbedret lader  Andel saker med korrekt identifisert rotårsak  Leverandørenes etterlevelse av avtale  Kostnad og ressursbruk mot budsjett       Du er sannsynligvis en god match hvis   Du har erfaring fra drift, teknologi eller industri, og har jobbet i grensesnittet mot produkt og kommersielt. God kommersiell forståelse og vilje til å prioritere det som er best for kundene våre, ikke hva det ropes høyest om, teller mye. description: The Impact You'll Make   As a  Global SIOP Manager , you will play a pivotal role in connecting demand, operations and inventories across our global manufacturing network. By helping Danfoss balance customer demand with production capabilities, you will directly influence business performance, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence.  This is a highly visible global role with responsibility across sites, where you will facilitate critical planning processes and help manufacturing teams anticipate and respond to changing market needs. As new business opportunities emerge, including growth segments such as data centers, your work will help ensure we have the right supply strategies and risk mitigation plans in place.  You will also lead the transition from  Anaplan to SAP IBP , shaping the future of operational planning while collaborating with stakeholders across supply chain, procurement, sales, manufacturing, and product management.  The position is a global role, which means it can be based e.g. in  Vaasa, Graasten, Kolding, or Chennai , working closely with international stakeholders and global manufacturing facilities. title: Customer Account Specialist
description: About Analog Devices   Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.   Company Introduction:  https://www.analog.com/en/index.html   Analog Devices (ADI) has just over $12 billion in revenue with offices around the world. As a global leader in the design and manufacturing of analog, mixed signal, power management and DSP integrated circuits, ADI is known for helping to solve its customers’ toughest engineering challenges. With a commitment to engineering for good, ADI strives to create a more sustainable future, while also focusing on its employees through mentoring programs, employee networks and continuous learning opportunities. The Specialist, Customer Operations is responsible for working with field sales to maintain and improve the business relationship between the customer and ADI Corporate. This position has high visibility within all departments at ADI and requires working closely with the various Business Units, Sales and Supply Chain to increase revenue at the customer. The Specialist, Customer Operations is required to add value at every level of transaction and communications, and act as an advocate for the customer within the company and at the same time represents ADI in all business transactions. While each brand has its own personality, where you will be able to truly find yourself, they all share a common ambition: to keep innovating and challenging the status-quo. Everything you will do with us, regardless of your profession, will offer a deep sense of meaning, to create lasting, memorable and impactful experiences for your customers, for your colleagues and for the planet.   Hospitality   is   a   work   of   heart  ,    Join   us and   become   a   Heartist  ®.    Job Description   Passionate about creating exceptional dining experiences through outstanding service, operational excellence, and strong leadership? As a Food & Beverage Manager, you will lead and oversee the hotel’s Food & Beverage operations, ensuring exceptional guest experiences, high service standards, and strong financial performance while inspiring and developing our Heartists.   What Is In It For You     Employee benefit card offering discounted rates at Accor properties worldwide.  Learning programs through our Academies and the opportunity to earn qualifications while you work.  Opportunity to develop your talent and grow within your property and across the world.  Ability to make a difference in the local community through our Corporate Social Responsibility activities, including Planet 21. Oversee the day to day operations of multiple Food & Beverage outlets, ensuring smooth and efficient service across all areas.  Personally lead and oversee F&B catering and high volume operations, maintaining a strong presence on the floor and ensuring operational excellence.  Ensure all Food & Beverage outlets consistently deliver exceptional guest experiences in line with luxury hospitality and brand standards.  Monitor service quality, guest satisfaction, productivity, and operational performance while ensuring compliance with hotel policies and brand standards.  Develop and implement strategies to maximize revenue, profitability, guest satisfaction, and overall F&B performance.  Take ownership of F&B financial

title: Care Lead - Saudi Arabia
description: Health can’t wait .  Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.  Alan exists to end the wait.  Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.  So we are building the  new standard in prevention insurance.  Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.  We are on an incredible journey to build a  global leading company, with a   unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.  Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.  ⭐ Your mission  We are building Alan's Care function in Saudi Arabia, and you will be the person who makes sure every member trusts Alan when they need us most. You'll build the function from zero: process, tooling, quality bar, then scale it, while handling the conversations that matter most yourself.   Founding the function     Handle directly the member contacts that stay in-house: admin requests, escalations, complex cases.  Write the scripts, guidelines, and documentation that make Care work in Saudi from day one.  Shape the operating model on the ground together with the GM Saudi and the global Care community: opening hours, shift coverage, tooling setup (Intercom and others), and how traffic splits between in-house and externalized support.      What success looks like:  a documented, working Care operation that can pass regulatory scrutiny and handle real member conversations from launch.    Owning quality on externalized support     Own the quality bar for everything we externalize: review calls and tickets in Arabic, coach our outsourcing partner's agents, and close the loop between what members experience and what we improve.      What success looks like:  externalized conversations meet Alan's quality bar, and gaps get caught and fixed before they become member complaints.    Owning regulatory accountability     Own the complaint-handling policy and the regulatory SLAs on complaints.  Prepare the documentation and readiness for the Insurance Authority inspection.      What success looks like:  Alan passes Insurance Authority inspection with a clear, accountable answer on every complaint-handling question asked.   You won't be building this alone. You'll have the full support of Alan's global Care Ops team on process design, tooling, forecasting, and planning, the same team behind our Care launches in France, Belgiu

Nous nous engageons au quotidien pour amplifier le pouvoir de projection et d’action des entrepreneurs, dirigeants et employés de TPE-PME qui contribuent à la compétitivité et la modernisation de notre pays.    🚀 Notre ambition    Avec le soutien du Groupe Crédit Agricole et de son réseau national historique (39 Caisses Régionales, 7000 conseillers) ainsi que du réseau LCL (1500+ conseillers),  Kolecto est en forte croissance et vise à accompagner la digitalisation de plus de 500 000 entreprises sur les prochaines années , en assumant sa fonction de pont durable entre la banque de proximité, les experts-comptables et l’écosystème de partenaires de confiance des TPE-PME.   🤩  Pourquoi rejoindre Kolecto ? Notre environnement de travail hybride unique, combinant le meilleur de l’environnement stimulant de la startup et la force de frappe d’un grand groupe bancaire leader.   Notre politique de télétravail flexible, qui permet jusqu'à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine en France.   Notre engagement pour l’égalité professionnelle, illustré par un Index égalité femmes-hommes de 99/100 en 2025, témoignant de notre vigilance constante sur l’équité des parcours et des rémunérations.   Nos événements internes fédérateurs : deux séminaires par an, talks inspirants, afterworks, etc.      🎯 Votre mission    La mission du CSS est d'accompagner nos clients dans la digitalisation de leur gestion administrative. title: Customer Operations Paris
description: About Pelico   Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.  We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.  Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.  This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.   About The Role   The mission of our Customer Operations team is simple: maximize Pelico's impact at the factory in the shortest time possible. CustOps owns the full deployment lifecycle — from onboarding to adoption to expansion — and shares the same incentives as our customers. You'll be measured on validated impact, not activity.  We hire from two buckets: young, hungry operators who figure things out fast; and ultra-resilient generalists who've navigated real operational chaos and come out the other side. Both paths work. What doesn't work: people who wait for a brief before moving.  The career ceiling here is genuinely unlimited. Any pilot can become an enterprise deployment, which can become the defining case study for an entire vertical — in 3-month cycles. CustOps is also a talent bench for the rest of Pelico: people have moved into Product, AI Ops, Pre-sales, and Leadership. The skills you build here travel everywhere.   What You'll Do     Own the successful deployment and adoption of Pelico at your customer sites — from kick-off to validated case study, in the shortest time possible.  Build genuine relationships with factory operators, plant managers, and supply chain directors — the kind where they'd take a reference call for you.  Quantify and communicate the impact Pelico delivers: shortage reduction, lead time improvement, team coordination. You make the value visible.  Partner with Sales to identify expansion opportunities and raise customer ambition — from pilot to enterprise deployment to vertical case study.  Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to relay structured field feedback that shapes the roadmap.  Contribu

description: Du weißt, dass „Bio“ mehr bedeutet als ein grünes Etikett, behältst bei 120 Sorten Obst und Gemüse den Überblick und weißt, dass Timing, Qualität und Teamwork im Frischebereich entscheidend sind? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen. Deutsch, Englisch von Vorteil)  Teamfähigkeit, Eigenmotivation, Prozessdenken und proaktive Arbeitsweise       WAS DIE ARBEIT „MIT SINN“ IN UNSERER BIOHOF-FAMILIE BESONDERS MACHT    Genieße kostenloses, frisches Bio-Obst & -Gemüse aus unserem Sortiment  Gönn dir ein Bio-Mittagessen (20% Rabatt) und eine kostenlose Suppe im hauseigenen Bio-Kulinarium  Erhalte 20% Rabatt auf all unsere Produkte im Biomarkt und auf die Biokiste  Profitiere vom Bio.g‘sund Gesundheitsförderungsprogramm (Physiotherapie, Leih-E-Bikes, Bio.g‘sund-Raum, etc.)  Nimm an kostenlosen oder ermäßigten Events (Kombucha-Workshop, Basenfasten, etc.) teil       ARBEITSZEIT    grundsätzlich 5-Tage-Woche, Montag bis Freitag  fallweise Samstagsdienst (ca. alle 6-8 Wochen) - in diesen Wochen hast du freitags frei      DU BIST EIN ECHTES VERKAUFSTALENT? title: Merchant Success
description: KPayについて  KPayグループは、シンプル・スマート・シームレス・セキュアなテクノロジーソリューションを通じて、あらゆる規模のビジネスの成長を支援する急成長中のフィンテック企業です。  現在、日本・香港・シンガポール・オーストラリアを中心に90,000以上の加盟店へサービスを提供し、決済、財務管理、業務オペレーションの効率化、そしてデジタルトランスフォーメーションを推進するワンストッププラットフォームを展開しています。  私たちは、テクノロジーの力で中小企業の成長を支援し、より良いビジネス環境の実現を目指しています。     募集ポジション   Merchant Success Specialist   勤務地：福岡  採用予定人数：4名     ポジションについて  加盟店の成功がKPayの成長につながる――。  Merchant Success Specialistは、加盟店がKPayのサービスを最大限活用できるよう支援し、長期的な関係構築を担うポジションです。  オンボーディングから活用促進、課題解決、リテンションまで一貫して担当し、顧客のビジネス成長をサポートしていただきます。  顧客と最も近い距離で接しながら、プロダクト改善やサービス向上にも貢献できる重要な役割です。     主な業務内容  ・加盟店へのオンボーディングおよび導入支援  ・顧客との継続的なコミュニケーションによる関係構築  ・サービス利用状況の分析および活用促進  ・顧客課題の特定および改善提案  ・顧客満足度向上および解約防止施策の実施  ・顧客フィードバックの収集およびプロダクトチームへの共有  ・営業、プロダクト、サポートチームと連携した課題解決  ・アップセルおよびクロスセル機会の発掘  ※主に電話・オンラインミーティングを通じて顧客とのコミュニケーションを行います。     応募資格  必須条件  ・カスタマーサクセス、マーチャントサクセス、法人営業のいずれかの経験  ・高いコミュニケーション能力  ・主体的に課題を発見し、解決に向けて行動できる方  歓迎条件  ・SaaSまたはITサービス業界での業務経験  ・アップセル、クロスセルの実務経験  ・顧客データ分析および改善提案の経験  ・スタートアップまたは成長企業での勤務経験     求める人物像  ・顧客の成功を第一に考えられる方  ・受け身ではなく、自ら顧客に価値提供できる方  ・変化の速い環境を楽しめる方  ・チームワークを重視しながら成果創出できる方  ・顧客との長期的な信頼関係を構築できる方     Why Join KPay?  ・急成長中のグローバルFinTech企業でキャリアを築ける  ・顧客の成功に直接貢献できるやりがいのあるポジション  ・営業、プロダクト、オペレーションなど幅広い部門と連携できる  ・顧客の声をサービス改善につなげることができる  ・スピード感のある環境で成長機会が豊富     勤務条件  雇用形態  正社員  ※試用期間3ヶ月（条件変更なし）     勤務時間  フルフレックス制度  標準労働時間：1日8時間（休憩60分）     想定年収  ~450万円     休日・休暇  ・完全週休2日制（土日祝休み）  ・年間休日125日  ・有給休暇  ・夏季休暇  ・年末年始休暇  ・特別休暇     福利厚生  社会保険  ・健康保険  ・厚生年金保険  ・雇用保険  ・労災保険  各種手当  ・交通費支給（実費支給）     Equal Opportunity Employer  KPay では、採用・評価・昇進を含むすべての雇用機会において公平性を重視しています。  人種、国籍、宗教、性別、性的指向、性自認、年齢、障がいの有無等による差別を行わず、多様なバ  ックグラウンドを持つ人材を歓迎しています。

当社において、企業の予実管理の課題を解決し続けることで、組織の距離を縮め、企業の未来の質を上げることへの貢献を期待します。 担当する顧客の属性（エンタープライズ・ミッドマーケット）やプロダクトのフェーズ（既存事業・新規事業）に応じ、顧客の経営課題解決と自社の事業成長にコミットしていただきます。 単なる操作説明ではなく、顧客のKPI達成を支援する「サクセスパートナー」として、以下の業務を推進していただきます。  【業務内容】 ◇オンボーディングと定着支援 顧客のゴールを定義し、最短距離でプロダクトを使いこなすための導入プロジェクトを推進する ◇管理会計のコンサルティング システム導入に留まらず、会計知見を活かして顧客の予実管理体制構築や業務プロセス改善に伴走し、管理会計における課題解決をする ◇LTVの最大化 定期的なヘルスチェックやデータ分析に基づき、追加機能や活用範囲の拡大を提案し、アップセル・クロスセルを実現する ◇CSプロセスの標準化・仕組み化 属人的な支援を脱し、成功事例の型化（マニュアル整備）や業務フローの自動化を通じて、組織全体の生産性を向上させる仕組みづくり ◇プロダクトフィードバック 顧客の声を収集・分析し、開発チームと連携してプロダクトの価値向上に繋げる ◇新規事業のPMF推進とサクセス仮説の検証 新規プロダクトの初期導入顧客に対するオンボーディングを通じて、顧客の「本当の課題」を深く理解し、サクセスの仮説検証と初期の勝ちパターンを探索  【ポジション魅力】 ◎経営層に対する直接的なアプローチ 企業のCFOや経営企画といった経営の中枢を担う層に対し、予実管理という根幹業務のコンサルティングを行うため、高いビジネス視座を養うことができます。 ◎SaaSビジネスの成長への直接的な寄与 顧客の成功が契約更新やアップセルという形で自社の収益成長に直結するため、事業が伸びる手応えをダイレクトに感じられます。 ◎組織をスケールさせるプロセス構築 拡大期の組織において、個人の成果を最大化するだけでなく、再現性のある支援フローの設計など、組織全体の生産性を高める基盤作りに携われます。  変更の範囲：会社の定める業務  【対象となる方(概要)】 ＜最終学歴＞大学院、大学卒以上 テクノロジーで、企業の成長可能性を掘り起こす。」をMissionに、ヒト・モノ・カネの最適配分を支えるプロダクトシリーズと、企業の経営ステージを進化させる伴走型の経営コンサルティングサービスを提供しています。「経営の動脈になる。組織に数字と意思を張り巡らせ、未来を動かす循環をつくる。」をCorporate Visionに、今後成長が見込まれる経営管理市場を牽引する会社として、企業成長に貢献します。  ■選ばれる理由： ・意思決定に必要な予実の最新情報・履歴がいつでも確認可能 自動でスナップショットが取得できるため、最新値だけでなく予算・見込の時点間比較も簡単に実現。差異要因を過去にさかのぼって特定することも可能。 ・各社のビジネスに適した管理会計の姿を実現 管理会計の専門システムだから、人員数やKPIなど非財務指標にも柔軟に対応。見るべきデータは、すべてDiggleへ。 ・経営企画がまるでもう一人増えたかのようなサポート体制 永年伴走するカスタマーサクセスはサービスだけでなく、管理会計領域のエキスパート。必要に応じて、業務フローの整理から支援を実施。 ・事業部を巻き込み、全社での予実管理意識が向上 直感的な操作と柔軟な権限設定を備え、全社展開実績多数。浸透させにくい予実管理を、データとともに共通言語に。  ■受賞歴：2026年6月時点 ・ITreview Grid title: Customer Relationship Manager
description: Description    About the Company   Join a privately owned NZ manufacturer who spent more than 35 years building a reputation as the market leader in premium architectural solutions, with product specified on residential, commercial, education and aged care projects nationwide. Designed, made and supported locally, it is a business that has grown on the strength of its product and its relationships rather than its advertising.  Role Purpose  The Customer Relationship Manager plays an important role in growing company reach and coverage by helping customers understand their needs, identify the right solution and confidently choose the right provider and brand. Working with architects, developers, builders and homeowners, the role manages customer enquiries and sales opportunities from initial contact through to completion, providing an outstanding customer experience and high-quality product and technical advice.  The role works closely with the Sales Manager and teams across Technical, Logistics, Training and Marketing to deliver great customer experience and contribute to growth as a leading provider of premium building systems. Commercially minded, with the ability to identify opportunities, progress leads, negotiate effectively and contribute to successful sales outcomes. description: We’re Building the Future of Capital Markets;  enabling entrepreneurship,  job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience  ‍   As Asia's leading securities brokerage, regulated exchange and fund management platform for alternative investments, Alta is at the forefront of building critical capital market infrastructure. We believe that access to capital markets are pivotal in all economies, we recognize that our role in building this critical infrastructure goes beyond facilitating trades; it paves the way for entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience, fostering a brighter future for emerging markets and economies.    Empowering Private Markets : Through our Digital Exchange, we enable the tokenization and digital custody of alternative assets. This end-to-end solution simplifies and expedites the trading of smaller asset blocks, ultimately facilitating access and liquidity in private markets. Established in 2016 and headquartered in Singapore, Alta operates offices globally. We welcome energetic and creative individuals to be part of this ambitious journey with us.  ‍   About The Role   We’re looking for a VP of Client Experience to build and lead the function at the heart of how our clients experience the business. 新規事業としてスタートしたFanGrowthはPMFを目指し急成長を続けており、今後の組織の拡大を見据えて積極的に募集を行っています。 今後は戦略的にプロダクトのコンパウンド化を進めていく方針のため、それぞれのプロダクトにおけるCSMの仕組みづくりを推進していくことが特に重要と捉えており、これまでのご経験を活かしていただきながら、急成長を続けるFanGrowthにてCSの仕組み作りと組織作りをお任せできる方を募集しています。  ■業務内容 CSの仕組みづくりからお任せし、マネジメント候補として将来的にはチームマネジメントや開発/営業など部門横断での合意形成などをお任せします。 具体的には以下のような業務を想定しています。 ・オンボーディング/アダプションスキームの構築・ブラッシュアップ ・モニタリングダッシュボード ・CRM管理基盤の構築 ・VoCの分析と開発チームへのフィードバック ・ハイタッチでの顧客折衝・アップセル提案 ・ロータッチ・テックタッチのスキームおよびコンテンツ作成  ■FanGrowthのCSとして得られるもの ・CS組織立ち上げの経験 プロダクトのコンパウンド化戦略のもと、新たにCSM組織を立ち上げることを想定しています。これまでのご経験を活かしながら、事業拡大のエンジンとして「プロフィットセンターとしてのCS組織」を目指した仕組み作りや組織立ち上げを中心となって実行していく経験を積んでいただけます。 ・強いプロダクトフィードバックサイクル 開発チームと密に連携して高速で開発を行っており、そのためCSMとして手触り感を持ってプロダクトの新機能開発や改善に取り組んで頂けます。将来的にPdMとしてご活躍いただくキャリアパスも想定しています。 ・PMFを目指し急成長をし続ける環境 FanGrowthはリリースから3年間PMFを目指し急成長を続けてきており、こうした成長のモメンタムを強く感じるフェーズの事業でのご経験は、今後のキャリアにとって大きな経験になるものと考えております。  ■エキサイトグループについて 新規プロダクトの初期導入顧客に対するカスタマーサクセス業務全般と、事業・プロダクト開発への最速のフィードバックループの構築を担っていただきます。 単なる操作説明にとどまらず、以下の業務を通じてPMF達成とサクセスの型化を推進していただきます。  【業務内容】 ◇新規事業のPMF推進とサクセス仮説の検証 ・顧客伴走を通じて「誰が真の顧客であり、どこに勝ち筋があるのか」を定義する、事業の羅針盤となる役割を担います。  ◎経営管理のスペシャリティを身に着け、将来の「事業家（BizDev）」へと越境できるキャリア ・顧客のCFOや経営企画の方と対等に対話し、ロジカルに課題解決する高度なビジネススキルが身につきます。 Expertise :  Une formation ou expérience en maintenance industrielle, ingénierie de la fiabilité ou génie mécanique est essentielle. Grâce à nos méthodes, produits et services innovants, nous gérons plus de 500 000 équipements et processus clients à travers le monde, en les aidant à réduire les risques pour une production plus sûre, plus efficace et plus durable. Le créateur de valeur :  Vous vous concentrez sur le retour sur investissement (ROI), en veillant à ce que le client perçoive l'impact financier du partenariat.    Le facilitateur :  Proactif, organisé et capable de maintenir des exigences élevées à travers un portefeuille varié. title: Customer Success Manager en santé
description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.  Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.  Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.   ⚡  Notre équipe Customer Success    L’équipe Customer Success, composée de 6 CSM, accompagne les établissements de santé après le déploiement de nos solutions.  Son rôle : faire en sorte que les équipes hospitalières utilisent Lifen au bon niveau, dans la durée, et qu’elles en tirent un bénéfice concret au quotidien.  Tu rejoindras l’équipe en charge des établissements publics les plus stratégiques. Le portefeuille regroupe des organisations aux configurations, aux usages et aux contraintes très différents. Il faut comprendre rapidement ce qui se passe chez chaque client, repérer les signaux faibles et mobiliser les bonnes personnes, côté client comme chez Lifen.  Le poste couvre les trois produits Lifen Care déjà déployés chez nos clients. Tu ne prends pas en charge le déploiement technique, le support ou les renouvellements contractuels. Ton terrain de jeu commence une fois les solutions en place : adoption, qualité des usages, satisfaction et prévention des risques.    🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous      Prendre en main un portefeuille d’établissements de santé (~35 hôpitaux et cliniques) et construire, pour chacun, une lecture précise des usages, des interlocuteurs, des points de blocage et des opportunités.   Faire décoller l’adoption après le déploiement : former les équipes, vérifier les premiers usages, corriger ce qui freine la prise en main et rapprocher l’usage réel des objectifs définis avec le client.   À partir des données disponibles, identifier les comptes qui nécessitent une action. Baisse d’usage, configuration inadaptée, insatisfaction, évolution de l’organisation : tu transformes ces signaux en plans d’action concrets.   Animer la relation avec les référents et chefs de projet côté client. Cela passe par des échanges réguliers à distance et environ un à deux déplacements par mois dans les établissements. description: JS2355 – ACCOUNT MANAGER    Settore Sanitario | Consulenza Applicativa | Provincia di Treviso   Per azienda operante nel settore sanitario e sociosanitario specializzata nello sviluppo di soluzioni software.   Cosa farai   Ti rapporterai con i referenti dei servizi sanitari e sociosanitari dei clienti, ricoprendo un ruolo trasversale tra consulenza applicativa e gestione della relazione con il cliente.  Nel dettaglio:   Collaborerai con il team di sviluppo nella definizione dei requisiti informativi e nella modellazione del software sulle esigenze del cliente;  Analizzerai i processi organizzativi dei clienti per comprenderne le esigenze e contribuire alla configurazione e personalizzazione delle soluzioni software;  Formerai i clienti sull'utilizzo degli applicativi e li supporterai nella fase di avviamento e adozione delle soluzioni, collaborando con il reparto IT interno per la gestione delle richieste e la risoluzione delle problematiche tecniche (senza svolgere attività di help desk);  Gestirai la relazione con i clienti come referente dedicato, contribuendo alla fidelizzazione e raccogliendo feedback utili al miglioramento continuo dei prodotti e dei servizi aziendali;  Organizzerai ed erogherai attività formative, monitorando l'avanzamento dei progetti e predisponendo la relativa reportistica;  Effettuerai trasferte presso clienti sul territorio nazionale, mediamente una volta al mese, ed eventuali partecipazioni a convegni ed eventi di settore.    Cosa ti chiediamo    Capacità di comunicare con interlocutori sia tecnici sia gestionali;  Ottime capacità organizzative, relazionali, orientamento al cliente e predisposizione al lavoro in team.    Cosa valorizzerebbe ulteriormente la tua candidatura    Esperienza di almeno 2-3 anni nel ruolo di account manager o in ambito commerciale;  Conoscenza del linguaggio e dei processi del settore sanitario e sociosanitario;  Esperienza nella gestione della relazione con il cliente, nella configurazione di software applicativi e nella formazione degli utenti;  Attitudine consulenziale, capacità di comprendere i processi del cliente e trasformarne le esigenze in soluzioni operative, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team tecnici interni;  Autonomia operativa, problem solving e capacità di gestire contemporaneamente più progetti.    Cosa ti offriamo    Inserimento diretto in azienda;  CCNL Commercio, RAL indicativa compresa tra 25.000 – 30.000 €  Possibilità di smart working parziale;   Ti invitiamo a leggere l'informativa sulla privacy sul sito di Cultura d'Impresa. title: Customer Care Team Lead
description: We power people’s progress.   At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.  We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.  Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.   Meet the team   Welcome to Preply’s Customer Support squad – the driving force behind delivering exceptional support experiences for our global community of learners and tutors.  We’re not just a support team; we’re performance-driven collaborators dedicated to setting new standards for excellence. At the heart of our mission is ensuring our customer support agents have the tools, guidance, and motivation they need to excel in providing the best customer support to learners and tutors. By fostering agents’ growth, enhancing their skills, and creating an environment of continuous improvement, we empower them to deliver outstanding service every day. description: ラピュタロボティクスについて    私たちは、「Empathy（共感）」というコアバリューに基づき、「きつい」「汚い」「危険」な仕事を自動化し、人々がより知的で創造的な仕事にチャレンジできる社会を実現したいと考えています。世界でも最先端の制御技術および人工知能技術を活用した、ロボティクスプラットフォームやロボットソリューションの開発と、企業への導入・運用支援を行うことで、この社会の実現を目指しています。  これまでの資金調達額は100億円以上にのぼり、毎年右肩上がりの成長を続けています。30ヶ国以上から200名以上の多国籍メンバーが集まり、日本・インド・アメリカを拠点に事業を展開しています。  現在弊社では、ロボティクス革命のさらなる推進に向けて、熱い志と豊かな才能を持った仲間を募集しています。   職種概要    Rapyuta Robotics(RR)において、複数の顧客導入プロジェクトを横断的に統括し、デプロイメントフェーズ全体をリードするポジションです。Forward Deployed Engineer(FDE)として自ら現場に入り込んだ実務経験を土台に、複数のFDE・複数案件を同時にまとめ、標準化と横展開を通じて組織としての導入成功率を高めることが最大のミッションです。個人としての実装力だけでなく、複数のFDEをマネジメントし、案件ポートフォリオ全体の優先順位付け・リソース配分・品質担保を行った経験が求められます。   主な業務内容     複数のデプロイメント/導入プロジェクトのポートフォリオ管理と優先順位付け   案件へのField Engineerアサイン調整、稼働状況のモニタリング   デプロイメント標準・プレイブック・ベストプラクティスの策定と横展開   Field Engineerの育成、技術・顧客対応レビュー、1on1   顧客エグゼクティブ・社内経営層への進捗・リスク報告   案件間で共通する課題の吸い上げと、プロダクト/エンジニアリング組織へのフィードバック   Field Engineerの採用要件定義・オンボーディング設計      Requirements    必須要件     複数の顧客導入プロジェクトを自らリードした実務経験   複数のメンバーをマネジメントし、並行稼働する複数案件をまとめた経験   案件のスコープ判断・優先順位付け・リソース配分の経験   顧客エグゼクティブおよび社内経営層との折衝・報告経験   デプロイメントプロセスの標準化・仕組み化を主導した経験      Benefits   個々の案件で成果を出すだけでなく、複数案件・複数メンバーを同時に見渡し、組織としての再現性を高められる方を求めています。  特に以下のようなタイプはDeployment Leadとの相性が良いと考えています。    複数案件を同時に見渡せる人:一つの現場の成功だけでなく、案件間の共通パターンを見出し、標準化やプレイブック化に落とし込める方。   人の成長に関心がある人:自ら手を動かすだけでなく、メンバーの技術的判断や顧客対応をレビューし、育成できる方。   優先順位付けに強い人:リソースが有限な中で、どの案件・どのメンバーに何を任せるかを見極め、経営層にも説明できる方。   技術とビジネスの橋渡しが好きな人:エンジニアにも顧客にも伝わる言葉で会話し、双方の期待値をそろえながら進められる方。

title: Payroll Implementation Consultant

title: Tiiminvetäjä myymälään - Stadium Trio
description: JOS SINULTA LÖYTYY TAHTOA, MEILTÄ LÖYTYY LOPUT!    Oletko sinä seuraava tähtipelaajamme?   Ovatko henkilökohtainen myynti, asiakaspalvelu ja aktiivinen elämäntapa intohimosi? Oletko kunnianhimoinen ja vuorovaikutustaitoinen joukkuepelaaja, joka ottaa mielellään vastuuta? Mahtavaa, saatat olla seuraava tähtipelaajamme! Järjestämme aktiviteetteja ja tapahtumia, jotka vahvistavat yhteisöllisyyttä, niin kentällä kuin sen ulkopuolella. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia vahvistaa osaamistasi myynnin parissa, ottaa lisää vastuuta ja edetä uusiin tehtäviin Stadiumin sisällä. Saat työkalut, sparrauksen ja joukkueen tuen, jotta onnistut ja löydät oman seuraavan pelipaikkasi.    Katso lisää työstä Stadiumilla urasivuiltamme, Instagramista @workatstadiumfinland tai LinkedInistä Stadium Finland.  ,   Mitä tarkoittaa olla tähtipelaaja Stadiumilla?   Tiiminvetäjänä edustat Stadiumia ja meille on ensiarvoisen tärkeää, että työntekijämme nauttivat työstään ja haluavat aktivoida maailmaa kanssamme. Haluamme, että asiakkaamme tuntevat olonsa tervetulleiksi Stadiumille, ja että asiakaskokemus on yhtenäinen läpi koko myymälän juoksuradan. Vastaat myymälästä silloin, kun myymäläpäällikkö ei ole paikalla.    Toivomme, että jaat ajattelutapamme ja näkemyksemme mahdollisuuksien löytämiseen haastavissakin tilanteissa. title: Key Account Manager
description: Key Account Manager – Belysning       Vill du utveckla affären med några av Sveriges viktigaste grossister?      Vi söker en affärsdriven och relationsstark  Key Account Manager  till ett etablerat internationellt företag inom professionell belysning.  Bolaget befinner sig i en spännande utvecklingsfas på den svenska marknaden och söker nu en person som får en central roll i att utveckla försäljningen av  armaturer och belysningslösningar , med särskilt fokus på några av marknadens viktigaste grossistkunder.  Det här är en roll för dig som förstår att framgångsrik Key Account Management handlar om betydligt mer än att ha en bra relation med inköpsavdelningen. Du behöver förstå kundens organisation, identifiera vilka personer som faktiskt påverkar affären och skapa engagemang för produkterna på flera nivåer.      Rollen   Som Key Account Manager får du ett tydligt kommersiellt ansvar för att utveckla försäljningen hos bolagets viktigaste grossistkunder.  Din uppgift är både att utveckla den strategiska relationen med respektive kund och att säkerställa att företagets produkter får rätt genomslag ute i grossistorganisationen.  Du kartlägger kundernas organisationer och identifierar  beslutsfattare, påverkare och andra nyckelpersoner  inom exempelvis inköp, kategori, försäljning, produktledning, filialorganisation och andra kommersiella funktioner.  Målet är att skapa ett tydligt  sug efter produkterna  – så att de inte bara finns tillgängliga i grossistens sortiment utan också blir produkter som organisationen känner till, rekommenderar och aktivt vill sälja.      Du kommer bland annat att    ansvara för och utveckla relationen med utvalda strategiskt viktiga grossistkunder  driva försäljning och skapa långsiktig tillväxt inom dina kundkonton  ta fram och genomföra konkreta kund- och aktivitetsplaner  kartlägga kundorganisationerna och identifiera de personer och funktioner som påverkar affären  bygga relationer på flera nivåer – från centrala beslutsfattare till personer närmare den operativa försäljningen  skapa aktiviteter som ökar kunskap, intresse och efterfrågan på företagets armaturer  arbeta tillsammans med grossisternas säljorganisationer för att öka genomslaget på marknaden  identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter och driva dem från idé till genomförd affär  följa upp försäljning, aktiviteter och resultat och kontinuerligt identifiera potentialen inom respektive kund  samarbeta nära med företagets övriga organisation inom bland annat försäljning, produkt, marknad och teknik.       Vem söker vi?      Vi söker framför allt en  kommersiell person med stark egen motor .  Du tycker om att utveckla kunder och är van vid att själv identifiera vad som behöver göras för att skapa affärer. Du är nyfiken på hur kundens verksamhet fungerar och nöjer dig inte med en enda kontaktperson – du vill förstå hela organisationen och vilka människor som behöver engageras för att skapa resultat.  Du är också bekväm med att kombinera det strategiska KAM-arbetet me

title: Account Manager
description: Haluatko tehdä myyntityötä, jossa asiakkaan liiketoiminnan ymmärtäminen on vähintään yhtä tärkeää kuin myyntitaidot?     Haemme Ferrometalille Account Manageria vahvistamaan kasvavaa myyntitiimiä. Tässä tehtävässä et myy yksittäisiä tuotteita, vaan toimit asiakkaidesi luotettavana kumppanina ja autat löytämään ratkaisuja teollisuuden tuotannon, kunnossapidon ja hankinnan tarpeisiin.  Voit työskennellä Tampereen tai Nurmijärven toimipisteeltä käsin. Ensisijaisesti etsimme vahvistusta Tampereen tiimiin, mutta myös Nurmijärven rekrytointi on mahdollinen.     Mikä tekee tehtävästä kiinnostavan?  Tarjolla on monipuolinen ja vastuullinen asiantuntijarooli vakaassa perheyhtiössä, joka on osa kansainvälistä Würth-konsernia. Ferrometal on yksi Pohjois-Euroopan johtavista kiinnitys- ja pientarvikeratkaisujen toimittajista teollisuudelle, joten pääset työskentelemään vahvojen tuotteiden, tunnettujen brändien ja kokeneen organisaation tukemana.  Pitkä historia, vakaa toimintaympäristö ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan tekemiseesi tarjoavat erinomaiset edellytykset onnistua sekä rakentaa pitkäaikaista uraa teollisuusmyynnin parissa.     Roolissa yhdistyvät:   olemassa olevien asiakkuuksien kasvattaminen  uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistaminen  tekninen ymmärrys ja konsultoiva myyntityö  yhteistyö teollisuuden avainpäättäjien kanssa      Asiakkaasi ovat tyypillisesti teollisuusyritysten hankinnan, tuotannon, kunnossapidon ja johdon avainhenkilöitä. Työssä menestyminen edellyttää kykyä käydä uskottavia keskusteluja niin ostajien, tuotantopäälliköiden kuin tehdasjohtajienkin kanssa.     Mitä työssä tehdään?  Account Managerina vastaat sekä nimettyjen asiakkuuksien kasvattamisesta että uusien asiakkaiden hankinnasta omalla alueellasi.     Työpäiviisi kuuluu muun muassa:   asiakkaiden liiketoiminnan ja tarpeiden kartoittaminen  uusien myyntimahdollisuuksien tunnistaminen  ratkaisujen ja palvelukokonaisuuksien rakentaminen  tarjousten laatiminen, neuvottelut ja kauppojen päättäminen  pitkäaikaisten asiakassuhteiden rakentaminen  yhteistyö Ferrometalin asiantuntijoiden kanssa      Liikut aktiivisesti asiakkaiden luona noin 150–200 kilometrin säteellä toimipisteestäsi. Matkustaminen tapahtuu pääosin päiväkäynteinä, ja yöpymisiä kertyy vain satunnaisesti.     Kuka tehtävässä menestyy?  Etsimme henkilöä, joka yhdistää kaupallisen osaamisen, teknisen ymmärryksen ja aidon kiinnostuksen teolliseen toimintaympäristöön.     Voit olla etsimämme henkilö, jos sinulla on:   kokemusta teollisuuden B2B-myynnistä tai teknisestä myynnistä  kyky ymmärtää asiakkaiden tuotantoa, hankintaa tai teknisiä toimintaympäristöjä  näyttöjä asiakkuuksien kasvattamisesta ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä  tavoitteellinen ja oma-aloitteinen työote  vahvat vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaidot  sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito  B-ajokortti      Arvostamme erityisesti kykyä tunnistaa asiakkaan tarpeita ja rakentaa niiden pohjalta toimivia ratkaisuja. Tässä tehtävässä menestyt luotta

title: Working Student Brand Ambassador (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

As our Working Student Brand Ambassador, you bring Mushroots directly to the people. Our products sit in the premium segment, and first-time buyers need to taste them before they commit. You make that happen — at supermarkets, festivals, trade fairs, and on our sampling bike across Hamburg.

  • Plan and coordinate tastings with supermarkets, festivals, and trade fairs independently

  • Self-starter who plans, coordinates, and executes without needing step-by-step guidance

  • Comfortable with a physical role: carrying equipment, standing for extended periods, cycling the sampling bike
  • Previous experience as a promoter or in event sampling is a plus, not a requirement
  • Genuine interest in Mushroots products and what Infinite Roots stands for


Our Benefits:

  • Dynamic and diverse mission-driven team from more than 20 different countries
  • A fast growing company with opportunities for personal development
  • Flexible working hours with entitled Home Office days in an innovative and agile working environment 
  • Gym Membership, language classes or an attractive alternative from our benefit program
  • Flat hierarchies and short decision paths
  • Great team events such as “lunch & learn”, “Demo Day”, cultural celebrations and food tastings

title: Security Architect
description:
Our mission

At LOGEX, we help healthcare providers improve outcomes through data-driven insights. Every day, hospitals and healthcare organizations across Europe rely on our financial, operational, clinical, and patient pathway data to make better decisions.

With that responsibility comes a clear commitment: keeping sensitive healthcare data secure, protected, and trusted.

We are looking for a Security Architect who is not only able to design secure solutions but also enjoys implementing them. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to make a tangible impact on security across our platforms, cloud environment, and engineering practices.

Your impact and responsibilities

As Security Architect, you will report directly to the Head of Information Security & Compliance and play a key role in strengthening LOGEX's security maturity. This is not a traditional enterprise architecture role focused on creating frameworks and presentations. We are looking for a security practitioner who enjoys rolling up their sleeves, working closely with engineering teams, solving real security challenges, and driving measurable risk reduction. You will work alongside software engineers, data engineers, and platform teams across multiple countries to ensure security is built into everything we do.

Your team

title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception.

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting.


These tasks interest you

  • Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences.

Job Description Summary

Our business purpose:
We are a purpose-driven team working to drive life-changing clarity in precision diagnostics that helps uncover what’s hidden inside the body – enabling earlier, more confident decisions in the fight against diseases like Alzheimer's, cardiovascular conditions, and cancer. As part of a company that delivers both radiopharmaceutical doses and the PET imaging infrastructure needed to use them, we play a critical role in expanding access to precision diagnostics – for providers, for systems, and most importantly, for patients. What sets us apart is a combination of unmatched clinical expertise, unwavering commitment to advancing science, as well as our deep commitment to showing up with urgency, care, and empathy – helping more people move from uncertainty to understanding. We believe that behind every scan is a heartbeat and behind every heartbeat is a story, and we treat each one like it matters – because lives are shaped in moments like these.
Who thrives here:
You’ll thrive here if you care deeply – about your teammates, about the people we serve, and about doing what’s right, even when it’s hard. You bring both heart and discipline to your work, with a curiosity to uncover what customers truly need and the courage to make a difference for patients. We work to remove ambiguity from patient care in a space where every decision matters, and collaboration isn’t optional – it’s how we move forward. As an Oncology Account Manager, your primary responsibility will be selling GE HealthCare’s PET Imaging Agent (Cerianna). This is a wing-to-wing, multi-faceted Account Manager role that has multiple call points and strategic priorities. Call points will primarily focus on PET Imaging Centers, PET technologists, Radiology Management, Radiologists, and Supply Chain. In addition, the role will help support driving demand and call on Medical Oncologists and Breast Surgeons to provide information and education on Cerianna, reimbursement resources, etc. to drive demand for the product into Imaging Centers. Third, a critical call point are pharmacy partners who manufacture the product and in-field collaboration to drive new business.
