Founded in 1990, WWT brings together strategy, deep technical expertise and world-class  partnerships to help public and private sector organizations design, build and scale intelligent AI, digital, cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure solutions. Through its Advanced Technology Center (ATC)—a collaborative ecosystem featuring state-of-the-art hardware and software—WWT enables clients and partners to conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology and then deploy solutions at scale using its global integration and distribution capabilities.  With more than 14,000 team members and over 60 locations globally, WWT's culture—grounded in core values and leadership philosophies—has been recognized by Fortune® and Great Place to Work for its commitment to innovation, trust and creating a great place to work for all. WWT provides products and services to large enterprise, global service provider and public sector clients in up to 130 countries across six continents. Softchoice, a World Wide Technology company, supports commercial and SMB markets in the U.S. and Canada.  Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high-performance teams? Join WWT today!   What will you be doing?   We are seeking a highly motivated Lifecycle Manager to join our team. This role is crucial in driving revenue growth and customer satisfaction through effective renewal management. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of the IT industry, excellent analytical skills, and a proven ability to build and maintain customer relationships.   Responsibilities:     Own the entire renewal lifecycle, including forecasting, negotiation, and closing deals.  Collaborate with sales and customer success teams to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities.  Develop and maintain accurate renewal forecasts, metrics reporting, and process workflows.  Analyze customer data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.  Implement process enhancements to improve renewal efficiency and customer experience.  Become an expert in co-terming and renewal consolidation strategies.  Maintain accurate customer records, including licenses, software expiration dates, and contact information within both internal tools and OEM portals.  Manage order statuses, updates, and drop-shipments.  Manage vendor relationships and resolve licensing and support issues.    ,   Qualifications:     Proven experience in renewals management.  Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel proficiency.  In-depth knowledge of IT equipment, data center configurations, and DC manufacturers (NetApp, Dell, HPE, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco, etc.).  In-depth knowledge of Software licensing (Microsoft, Splunk, Tenable, etc.)  Experience with data analysis and reporting.  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: MyDr  (jedna ze spółek grupy  Docplanner ) to zespół pasjonatów nowych technologii, którzy od podstaw stworzyli i nadal rozwijają zaawansowane programy do prowadzenia Elektronicznej Dokumentacji Medycznej i kompleksowego zarządzania przychodniami.   Od 2017 z powodzeniem rozwijamy się i utrzymujemy status lidera w pełni chmurowych rozwiązań EDM na rynku oprogramowania medycznego w Polsce.  Z naszego produktu na co dzień korzysta ponad 65 tysięcy Użytkowników, którzy dbają o bezpieczeństwo medyczne Polski.  W związku z otwarciem nowego obszaru w naszej organizacji, poszukujemy doświadczonego CS Managera, który od podstaw zbuduje i poprowadzi naszą strukturę  Customer Success. Jest to rola hybrydowa w trybie 2 dni pracy w biurze + 3 dni pracy zdalnej.    Jakie zadania na Ciebie czekają?    Budowanie i Architektura Procesów CS Od Podstaw     Mapowanie i projektowanie pełnego ścieżki klienta (Customer Journey) - od momentu domknięcia sprzedaży po wieloletnią współpracę.  Tworzenie i wdrażanie kluczowych procesów CS: onboardingu klientów, strategii retencji, działań anty-churnowych.  Wdrażanie i dostosowanie narzędzi klasy CS / CRM do potrzeb nowo powstających procesów.  Zdefiniowanie wskaźników sukcesu (KPI/OKRs dla obszaru CS).     Tworzenie i Rozwój Zespołu     Budowanie i skalowanie nowej struktury zespołu Customer Success (rekrutacja, onboarding pracowników, ustalanie standardów pracy).  Bieżące wsparcie, coaching i wyznaczanie kierunków rozwoju dla przyszłych członków zespołu CS.  Egzekwowanie najwyższych standardów jakości w kontaktach z klientami i prowadzeniu spotkań biznesowych.     Podejście sprzedażowe i rozwój klientów     Współpraca przy budowaniu i optymalizacji lejków sprzedażowych wewnątrz istniejącej bazy klientów.  Aktywny udział w kluczowych lub trudniejszych rozmowach biznesowych i negocjacjach umów.  Łączenie doskonałej obsługi i edukacji klienta z budowaniem wartości biznesowej (zwiększanie adopcji produktów)     Współpraca Strategiczna     Ścisła współpraca ze strukturami Globalnymi / Zarządem w zakresie raportowania, dostosowywania procesów i wdrażania inicjatyw.  Merytoryczne wsparcie dla zespołów Sales, Expansion oraz Customer Care w celu zapewnienia spójnego doświadczenia klienta.  Współtworzenie długoterminowej strategii wzrostu firmy w oparciu o feedback i potrzeby klientów.     Kogo szukamy?    Doświadczenie     Poparte sukcesami doświadczenie w budowaniu od zera lub gruntownej przebudowie obszaru Customer Success / Account Management.  Min. 2 lata doświadczenia w zarządzaniu zespołami CS lub sprzedażowymi (SaaS / B2B).  Tło sprzedażowe i biznesowe (znajomość mechanizmów upsellu, negocjacji i zarządzania wskaźnikiem churn).  Doświadczenie w tworzeniu procesów, procedur oraz wdrażaniu narzędzi wspomagających pracę CS.     Kompetencje i Cechy Osobowościowe     Wysoka sprawczość i inicjatywa duża samodzielność, inicjatywa i wysoka odporność na zmianę oraz pracę w środowisku o niskim stopniu ustrukturyzowania na starcie.

title: Deployment Strategist
description: What You'll Do    As a Deployment Strategist at Wonderful, you are responsible for making AI deployments actually land.  Wonderful is the AI operating system for enterprises, helping them close the gap between what AI enables and how they operate today. You lead enterprise customers from early discovery through pilot and production rollout, translating ambitious AI initiatives into clear scopes, executable plans, and measurable outcomes. You sit between the customer, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Product, ensuring everyone is aligned on what is being built, why it matters, and how it will succeed in production.  This is a hands-on role for people who enjoy ambiguity, ownership, and seeing complex projects through to the end.    Embed deeply with customers to understand their processes and systems, identify the most important problems to solve, and obsess over helping them win.   Lead discovery with enterprise customers to understand workflows, constraints, and success criteria.   Define scope, success metrics, and integration plans for pilots and rollouts.   Translate customer needs into clear deployment plans for engineering teams.   Coordinate deployments across Product, Engineering, and customer stakeholders.   Track progress, manage risks, and remove blockers throughout the deployment.   Support production launches and ensure solutions are adopted and working as intended.   Monitor deployed agents and drive follow-up improvements based on real usage.   Identify additional use cases and expansion opportunities with customers.     You will spend time onsite with customers, working through real constraints, answering difficult questions, and ensuring solutions deliver real value.    Why Should You      You’ll be part of what is tipped as the fastest-growing startup in Europe.   Work on a cutting-edge agentic solution, the hottest topic in Enterprise right now.   You’ll join a team of high-agency builders coming from the best tech companies out there.   Never boring - you’ll be solving problems for and with the biggest Enterprises in the world.       Who You Are      Experience in deployment-focused, technical, or execution-oriented roles.   Strong ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into concrete plans.   Comfort working with technical concepts such as APIs, MCP, data flows, and system integrations.   Clear communication and strong stakeholder management skills.   High ownership mindset and bias toward action.   Interest in building and deploying AI-powered systems in real environments.       Nice To Have      Background in solutions engineering, technical consulting, or forward-deployed roles.   Prior hands-on engineering experience.   Experience supporting production software launches.   Experience working in high-growth or early-stage environments. title: Customer Success Manager
location: Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
description: ABOUT THE ROLE  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------  HitPay builds omnichannel payment infrastructure for growing businesses across  Asia-Pacific. Tens of thousands of businesses use us to accept payments online and  in person, across Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines and beyond.  This is a new role, and the first of its kind here. You will own the relationship  between HitPay and the businesses already using us — making sure they get set up  properly, stay successful, and tell us when something is not working.  The remit is regional. Your book spans every market we operate in, not one country,  and it grows as we open new ones. That means learning what "unhappy" looks like in  markets with different payment habits, different competitors and different  expectations about how quickly money should arrive — and spotting when a problem is  local versus when it is ours everywhere.  It sits deliberately between teams. Support handles day-to-day questions.  Compliance owns verification and risk. Sales brings new businesses in. You own  what happens to a partner across all three, which is where good businesses are  most easily lost.  WHAT YOU WILL OWN  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------  1. Partner health  Work a prioritised list of partners who need attention — because they have hit  friction, gone quiet, or told us they are unhappy. Reach out, diagnose, and  either resolve or escalate. Every partner on that list gets an owner and an  outcome, not a status.  2. The first 90 days  A business that signs up and never reaches steady processing has been lost just  as surely as one that leaves loudly, and far more quietly. Own activation from  first transaction to established volume: what stalls, why, and what unblocks it.  3. Retention and win-backs  Run retention conversations directly, including commercial discussions where  the case supports one. Reopen conversations with partners who have gone quiet.  4. The feedback loop  Take root causes back to the teams that own them — product, pricing,  compliance, support — with evidence attached. Push for the change, and follow  it through. This is the part of the job most likely to be neglected and most  likely to matter.  5. Measurement  Define how we measure partner retention and activation across markets, report  it on a regular cadence, and keep it honest.  WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------  The remit spans onboarding, support and compliance handoffs, so boundaries matter.  You own the partner's outcome across these seams — you do not take over the  functions themselves.  · Not verification or onboarding review. Compliance owns approval, rejection and risk decisions. You represent the partner's experience of those decisions.  · Not the front-line support queue. Support owns first response and day-to-day resolution. You pick up the accounts where

title: Agent Tools Strategy & Operations Specialist
description: 🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!   We are looking for an Agent Tools Strategy & Operations Specialist to own the tooling and processes that power our support agents — and to make every agent faster, more accurate, and more effective.  This role sits at the intersection of operations and product. You will define what our agent tools need to do, streamline the processes agents follow, and partner with Product and Engineering to build and improve the systems that make seamless, semi-automated support possible. You will ultimately move the classic support metrics — handle time, first contact resolution, and quality — but through a process and tooling lens, not through direct management of the agent team.  This is a strategic, data-driven position. We are looking for a brilliant generalist who can deeply own the agent-experience problem space today while evolving into broader CX strategic initiatives as the organization grows.   🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On    Own the Agent Tooling & Process Problem End-to-End     Understand, at an operations level, what agents need from their tools — and translate that into clear functional requirements and roadmaps.  Map and streamline the end-to-end processes agents follow, removing friction, manual steps, and rework.  Own the strategy and operations of core tooling capabilities such as case management and routing, agent assignment and capacity management, customer identification, and consolidation of fragmented tools into a unified workflow.  Identify where semi-automation, templating, and guided workflows can reduce effort and error.     Partner with Product & Engineering to Build the Tools     Define product feature requirements and roadmaps together with Product and Engineering.  Develop project plans across stakeholder groups to ensure successful development and deployment of features.  Act as the quality-assurance arm of development — flag critical quality blockers and risks ahead of feature launches. title: Solutions Transitie en Implementatiemanager
description: Securitas ontwikkelt zich als solutions-gedreven organisatie met als doel wereldwijd marktleider te zijn in Security Solutions. Vanuit Solutions Delivery realiseert de organisatie complexe integrale beveiligingsoplossingen waarin technologie, mobiele surveillance, monitoring en beveiliging samenkomen. De afdeling vormt de schakel tussen sales, operatie en klant en is verantwoordelijk voor de succesvolle implementatie van deze oplossingen. Door de groei van de dienstverlening, de ontwikkeling van medewerkers en de toenemende impact op de organisatie is deze functie ontstaan. De internationale Solutions-organisatie biedt daarnaast interessante doorgroeimogelijkheden.  Als Solutions Transitie- en Implementatiemanager maak je deel uit van de afdeling Solutions Delivery. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de succesvolle implementatie van integrale beveiligingsoplossingen bij strategische klanten. Deze oplossingen bestaan uit een combinatie van technologie, monitoring, mobiele surveillance, manbeveiliging en aanvullende security services, afgestemd op de specifieke risico's, dreigingen en bedrijfsprocessen van de klant.  Je bent al betrokken tijdens de salesfase en neemt na opdrachtverstrekking de regie over het implementatietraject. Bij wijzigingen in klantwensen of projectscope analyseer je de impact op zowel de klantorganisatie als Securitas. Je signaleert risico's, stuurt tijdig bij en zorgt ervoor dat projecten gecontroleerd, beheerst en succesvol verlopen. title: Deployment Strategist
description: What You'll Do    As a Deployment Strategist at Wonderful, you are responsible for making AI deployments actually land.  Wonderful is the AI operating system for enterprises, helping them close the gap between what AI enables and how they operate today. You lead enterprise customers from early discovery through pilot and production rollout, translating ambitious AI initiatives into clear scopes, executable plans, and measurable outcomes. You sit between the customer, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Product, ensuring everyone is aligned on what is being built, why it matters, and how it will succeed in production.  This is a hands-on role for people who enjoy ambiguity, ownership, and seeing complex projects through to the end.    Embed deeply with customers to understand their processes and systems, identify the most important problems to solve, and obsess over helping them win.   Lead discovery with enterprise customers to understand workflows, constraints, and success criteria.   Define scope, success metrics, and integration plans for pilots and rollouts.   Translate customer needs into clear deployment plans for engineering teams.   Coordinate deployments across Product, Engineering, and customer stakeholders.   Track progress, manage risks, and remove blockers throughout the deployment.   Support production launches and ensure solutions are adopted and working as intended.   Monitor deployed agents and drive follow-up improvements based on real usage.   Identify additional use cases and expansion opportunities with customers.     You will spend time onsite with customers, working through real constraints, answering difficult questions, and ensuring solutions deliver real value. You’ll join a team of high-agency builders coming from the best tech companies out there.   Never boring - you’ll be solving problems for and with the biggest Enterprises in the world.       Who You Are      Experience in deployment-focused, technical, or execution-oriented roles.   Strong ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into concrete plans.   Comfort working with technical concepts such as APIs, MCP, data flows, and system integrations.   Clear communication and strong stakeholder management skills.   High ownership mindset and bias toward action.   Interest in building and deploying AI-powered systems in real environments.       Nice To Have      Background in solutions engineering, technical consulting, or forward-deployed roles.   Prior hands-on engineering experience.   Experience supporting production software launches.   Experience working in high-growth or early-stage environments.       Why This Role Exists    Enterprises are ready to use AI, but execution is the hard part.  This role exists to bridge that gap. You will help customers deploy AI agents

description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About this role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

title: Head of Finance & Data (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Zahlen sind deine Leidenschaft, und du willst die Datenbasis dahinter nicht nur nutzen, sondern selbst gestalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als Head of Finance & Data (m/w/d) bist du das strategische und technische Fundament für unser weiteres Wachstum.

In dieser vielseitigen Doppelrolle verbindest du messerscharfe Zahlenkompetenz mit einem echten Gespür für Datenarchitektur und Reporting-Infrastruktur. Du baust nicht nur ein stabiles Controlling auf, sondern gestaltest parallel die technische Grundlage, auf der unser gesamtes Unternehmen datenbasierte Entscheidungen trifft. Kurz: Du hältst uns den Rücken frei und lenkst aktiv unseren Erfolgskurs mit.

  • Strukturen schaffen: Du baust belastbare Controlling-Strukturen und Reportings mit einer klaren, zukunftsorientierten Steuerungslogik auf.
  • Finanzen im Griff: Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Finanzplanung, das Reporting und die strategische finanzielle Steuerung.
  • Data-Infrastruktur gestalten: Du treibst den Aufbau unserer automatisierten Datenpipelines voran (u. a. BigQuery, angebunden an Shopify, Klaviyo und weitere Quellen) und sorgst dafür, dass Kennzahlen zuverlässig, aktuell und zentral verfügbar sind.
  • BI & Controlling verzahnen: Du entwickelst unsere Dashboards und Reporting-Tools (z. B. Looker Studio) so weiter, dass Finance-Kennzahlen und operative Daten in einem konsistenten Bild zusammenlaufen.
  • Prozesse skalieren: Du etablierst effiziente, smarte Prozesse im Finance- und Data-Bereich, die mit uns mitwachsen.
  • Sparring auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CEO zusammen und berätst ihn als geschätzter Sparringspartnerin in allen strategischen Finanz- und Datenfragen.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - B2B platform (Laravel + Nuxt/Vue)
description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.


The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Senior Full-Stack Engineer to architect high-performance web applications and accelerate our development velocity across our B2B platform. You’ll play a pivotal role in bridging modern Nuxt 3/4 frontend applications—including customer management portals and embeddable widget engines—with a robust Laravel and Doctrine ORM backend API, delivering seamless experiences that connect millions of students to funding opportunities.

You will own the technical implementation of core products across our entire stack, working with PHP 8.2+, Laravel, MySQL, and Vue 3 / Nuxt 3/4. Beyond traditional engineering, this role champions efficiency: you will deeply integrate AI-native workflows (using tools like Cursor and Google Gemini) to double shipping velocity, automate test coverage, and build intelligent LLM-driven platform features. If you are passionate about full-stack architecture, widget infrastructure, and leveraging AI to build smarter and faster, this role is for you.

  • Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an
  • Extrem steile Lernkurve durch direkte Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen AI-First-Entwicklern

Du bist sicher in Microsoft-Umgebungen – aber keine Lust, deine Zeit im First- und Second-Level zu verbrennen? Und du willst Projekte endlich selbst umsetzen, statt sie nur zu koordinieren?

Für einen Managed Service Provider aus Lübeck – Teil eines bundesweit wachsenden IT-Netzwerks – suche ich Verstärkung fürs Technik-Team. title: (Senior) Applied Scientist, Recommendations
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is part of DoorDash - together we form one of the world's largest local commerce platforms. We build recommendation systems that help customers discover the most relevant restaurants, dishes and items throughout their Wolt experience.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to advance the machine learning models behind these experiences. You'll work on challenging applied ML problems where model quality, product decisions and customer experience are tightly connected. This is an opportunity to take ideas from problem framing and data analysis through experimentation, production deployment and measurable customer impact.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineers turn what Luma's models can do into systems customers actually rely on. You embed with a customer, learn their workflow, define the problem with them, and build the production system that solves it, with their data and their constraints. You own both the relationship and the code.

This is engineering at the edge, where ambiguity is the default and "what should we build?" is yours to answer. It's built for people who've already been the single point of ownership on a hard problem: a technical founder, the engineer who flew out and rebuilt a customer's workflow, a consultant who actually wrote the system. If you need a PRD and a well-defined ticket queue, this isn't it.

What You'll Own

  • Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and goals, and define the problem yourself.

  • Build production systems on Luma's APIs, models, and internal tools.

  • Prototype, ship, iterate, and maintain systems customers depend on in real environments with real data.

  • Own projects end to end, from first conversation to deployed system.

  • Build around platform gaps when something's missing, and feed recurring patterns back to platform and R&D to productize.

  • Use AI to accelerate implementation, while the core of the work stays engineering judgment: what to build and how to make it reliable.

First 90 Days

One way the first 90 could unfold.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legals and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why We're Hiring

We're hiring across product, design, engineering, growth, legal and operations - and our US launch will add New York hiring on top of that. Hiring the right people is central to our success to not have someone focused on it entirely.

You'll find exceptional people, but you won't just be the person holding everyone to a bar - you'll work with the founders and leadership team to shape what that bar actually looks like.

This isn't a role where you speak to candidates and move them through a process. You'll understand the product, business and teams deeply enough to assess people properly, challenge hiring managers when needed, and hold the business to the same standar

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. title: Senior Software Engineer  (Java)
description:
About ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

What we're looking for

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performing backend systems that power our innovative products. You’ll collaborate with a talented team to create solutions that drive financial inclusion and transform the way people manage their money.

What you'll be doing

  • The work will focus on greenfield development and improvement of existing systems

  • Projects will include building REST APIs, engineering microservices and evolving a number of systems that our business depends on (e.g. card payments, treasury management, transactions booking, crypto liquidity)

  • Our technology stack is based predominantly on Java 25 on the backend with Postgres database

  • We rely on Spring Boot for quick and quality delivery

  • We have a pragmatic approach to develop our business logic, focusing on clean code, with emphasis on maintainability and fast turnaround with TDD, DDD and continuous integration & delivery

What you'll need

  • Demonstrable experience in Backend development, with fluency in Java

The Mission: Source.dev

Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework, Security, and the Android Runtime (ART).

Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation.

Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS.

The Core Product: SourceFS

SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes.

  • 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed.

title: Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within KIRA's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

title: IT System Engineer (m/w/x)
description:
Tiermedizin neu gedacht - mit dir!

Rex hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, Tierhalter:innen dabei zu helfen, sich optimal um ihre besten Freunde kümmern zu können.
Um dies zu erreichen, wollen wir die tierärztliche Versorgung von Grund auf neu gestalten, wobei wir uns zum einen auf die Zufriedenheit und die Entwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden im Team und zum anderen auf ein verbessertes Kundenerlebnis konzentrieren.
Bei uns wird Deine Stimme nicht nur gehört, sondern wir brauchen Deine Erfahrung und Deine Perspektive, um Rex noch schneller weiter wachsen zu lassen.


Warum bei Rex? Ganz einfach:

Wir stellen uns der komplexen Herausforderung, die Veterinärmedizin digital zu transformieren. Dafür entwickeln und betreiben wir eine hochverfügbare, skalierbare Plattform, die sowohl eine herausragende Customer Experience als auch effiziente, datengestützte Praxisabläufe ermöglicht.

Da wir kontinuierlich neue Praxen eröffnen und unsere Präsenz in Deutschland ausbauen, suchen wir jemanden, der sicherstellt, dass jeder neue Standort ab Tag 1 technisch startklar ist – und dass die Infrastruktur hinter unserer Plattform mit unserem Wachstum sicher und stabil bleibt. Baue und betreue die Systeme, die unsere Expansion erst möglich machen!


Spannende Aufgaben warten auf Dich:

Als unser IT System Engineer sorgst Du für verlässliche Systeme und treibst exzellente Prozesse in folgenden Bereichen voran:

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
⭐️ Your Impact:

The European trades are one of the least digitised industries left. Software
penetration sits under 15%, against roughly 70% in the US. The labour
productivity gap runs about 30%. Millions of skilled people spend their evenings
on paperwork instead of the craft they trained for — in the industry that has to
deliver the energy transition.

There is almost no incumbent software to displace. That is unusual, and it won't
last.

smalt replaces the back office entirely rather than selling Meister another tool
to manage. In the last six months that went from a partner app and a dashboard
to around thirty AI agents in production - pricing real jobs, qualifying real
leads, running the operations of businesses whose payroll depends on it working.

These days building thirty agents is easy. Knowing which thirty is what's challenging.

That only comes from being in the Betrieb and talking to the Handwerker.

That's what this role is for.

What you'll do

You'll sit in Handwerksbetrieben - at the Meister's desk, in the van, on site, next to our team -
and watch how the work actually happens. Then you'll come back and build the
thing that fixes it, often multiple times on the same day.

- Spend real time with partners. Not a quarterly customer call. You'll know
  our Meister by name, understand their P&L, and notice the thing they've
  stopped complaining about because they assume it can't be fixed.
- Build across the stack. Python/FastAPI services, Vue interfaces, Flutter
  screens, agent loops, data pipelines - whatever the problem needs.
- Own agents in production. Not demos. Agents that price real jobs, answer
  real customers, and cost real money when they're wrong. Reliability,
  evaluation, structured output, graceful failure.
- Decide what to build.

title: Customer Relationship Management Manager
description: Company Description       Roza is a thoughtfully curated clothing brand grounded in timeless elegance, sustainability, and slow fashion. The brand blends modern aesthetics with traditional craftsmanship, creating clean, minimal silhouettes that highlight the beauty of handwoven textiles. Each collection starts with fabrics crafted by master artisans across India, honoring their heritage while reimagining them for contemporary wardrobes. With a focus on enduring materials such as aging linens, hand-painted florals, and sustainable silks, Roza designs garments intended to last beyond trends and seasons. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.       Experience   A minimum 4-5 years in CRM is required. Must have the ability to run a team and steer towards desired goals.

title: Teammanager Klantenservice
description: Hoe maak jij onze klanten blij?   Als Teammanager Klantenservice binnen De Service Hub zorg je ervoor dat klanten vandaag goed geholpen worden én dat de klantenservice van morgen steeds slimmer, beter en mensgerichter wordt. Je geeft leiding aan een team van ongeveer 20 Service Experts en speelt daarnaast een belangrijke rol in het verbeteren van processen, samenwerking en kwaliteit. Met jouw coachende stijl, scherpe blik en gevoel voor operatie help je niet alleen je team vooruit, maar versterk je ook de dienstverlening als geheel.   De grootste uitdaging   De Service Hub is binnen bol dé plek waar vernieuwing in klantcontact tastbaar wordt. Nieuwe processen, systemen en werkwijzen worden hier vaak als eerste getest, aangescherpt en gevalideerd. Dat maakt deze rol breder dan alleen operationeel leidinggeven.  Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse performance van je team, maar kijkt ook continu vooruit: wat kan slimmer, beter of menselijker? Daarom zoeken we geen manager die alleen op output stuurt, maar iemand die ontwikkeling stimuleert, eigenaarschap vergroot en samen met anderen bouwt aan blijvend betere service.   Wat je doet   Je combineert people management met procesverbetering en kwaliteitssturing. Je helpt medewerkers groeien, creëert een omgeving waarin feedback en ontwikkeling centraal staan en zorgt dat jouw team stevig staat in een dynamische serviceomgeving.  Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met andere teammanagers, specialisten en projectteams om inzichten uit de praktijk te vertalen naar verbeteringen die verder reiken dan je eigen team.   Waarom jij het verschil kunt maken      Je coacht en ontwikkelt Service Experts, zowel individueel als op teamniveau, zodat zij met vertrouwen en eigenaarschap hun werk kunnen doen.   Je creëert een veilige en open werkomgeving waarin samenwerken, leren en feedback centraal staan.   Je monitort prestaties, kwaliteit en klantfeedback en vertaalt signalen naar concrete verbeteracties.   Je draagt samen met je team bij aan pilots en verbeterinitiatieven rondom processen, systemen en klantcontact.   Je vertegenwoordigt de stem van de operatie binnen grotere, bol-brede projecten en helpt mee aan toekomstbestendige service.   Je werkt intensief samen met andere teammanagers en specialisten om de afdeling als geheel sterker te maken.     Hier kom je terecht   Je komt terecht in De Service Hub in Utrecht: een omgeving waar klantcontact, innovatie en ontwikkeling samenkomen. Hier wordt continu getest, geleerd en verbeterd. Dat vraagt om mensen die nieuwsgierig zijn, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en graag samenwerken.  Je werkt hybride, met minimaal 2 dagen per week op kantoor. Woensdag is de vaste kantoordag binnen De Service Hub. Omdat de klantenservice 7 dagen per week bereikbaar is van 08.00 tot 23.00 uur, draai je ook avond- en weekenddiensten en maak je samen met de andere teammanagers het rooster.   Something for you?     Als je...: energie krijgt van het coachen en ontwikkelen van mensen en tea

title: Staff Design Engineer - UK
description:
Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

  • Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

  • Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

  • Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

  • You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. You’ll get to test out ideas with our own recruiting team and hiring managers who use Ashby every day (like me), and often hear customer feedback as early as the day you release.

  • This role has always had the commitment of both Benji (CEO & Co-Founder) and me: I’ve held the role, steadfastly championed it since we started hiring in 2020, and haven’t diluted its responsibilities as we’v

About the role

You will own the EEA growth campaign engine, which mainly comprises of 4 types: Affiliate, Listing, Trade & Earn, and New Product Launches. This is both a coordination and execution role. You will be the single accountable owner who turns a campaign concept into a shipped, measured, and reflected-upon outcome by orchestrating creative, media, lifecycle, BD, KOL ops, product marketing, and legal.   5. Be the connective tissue between EEA Growth and Global Campaigns. Localise global playbooks to EEA markets. Push EEA-originated wins back to global for global ex

At Mural, we're changing how teams collaborate, think, and make decisions together. The Growth & Engagement team owns the experiences that turn a single-player tool into a multiplayer habit: the loops that bring people back, help them find their work, and pull their colleagues into a mural. Mural's self-serve growth runs through these experiences, and engagement and retention are central to how the business grows.

YOUR MISSION

As Senior Product Manager, Growth & Engagement, you will own the end-to-end self-serve experience, from a user's first touch through activation, return usage, and conversion to paid. Buena baut die Technologie, auf der die Immobilienbranche läuft. title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering (Revenue Operations)
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

title: Senior Product Designer - Platform and Partner Experience
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join the Partner and Platform Experience (PPX) team. You'll tackle problems where social dynamics, device ecosystems, and technical constraints intersect. It's work that demands systems thinking, deep comfort with technical complexity, and a drive to make complex interactions feel simple and engaging.


What You'll Do

  • Design experiences that help listeners share moments together and move effortlessly between the devices and platforms around them.

  • Own complex design problems from early exploration through execution, balancing user needs, technical constraints, and product opportunities.

  • Create thoughtful, polished user experiences with a strong focus on interaction design, visual craft, and the details that make an experience feel intuitive.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to understand the technology behind the experience and turn complex systems into simple experiences for listeners.

  • Explore how experiences scale across mobile, desktop, TVs, speakers, cars, and other surfaces in the Spotify ecosystem.

  • Use prototyping to explore, communicate, and test ideas, including AI-assisted and code-based approaches where they help us learn faster.

title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.

We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.

You'll help answer questions such as:

  • Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?
  • Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?
  • What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?
  • Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?
  • How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?

If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation.

title: Staff AI Deployment Strategist - UK & Nordics
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As Staff AI Deployment Strategist, you will shape how some of the most ambitious enterprises in the UK & Nordics region adopt frontier AI at scale.

This is a senior, high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution. You will work directly on Mistral’s most strategic opportunities and largest deliveries, helping customers move from ambition to measurable business outcomes. You will frame complex AI transformation programs, turn executive priorities into actionable roadmaps, and ensure that Mistral delivers systems that are valuable, scalable, and trusted.

You will also act as a senior sponsor on our most critical customer programs, bringing judgment, structure, and delivery excellence to high-stakes engagements. Your mandate is to raise the ambition and quality of AI adoption: helping customers identify where AI can create step-change value, making the right trade-offs, and ensuring that execution matches the strategic promise.

title: (Mandatory) Internship Technical Founder's Associate (m/w/d)
description:
About CyFract

We are a deep-tech startup on a mission to fundamentally change how we treat the world's most valuable resource: water. Founded in 2022, we develop a patented uniflow hydrocyclone that removes suspended solids without membranes, consumables or moving parts, at a fraction of the energy conventional systems require. Having completed the UnternehmerTUM Incubator and a €3M project financed by SPRIN-D (German Federal Agency for Disruptive Innovation), we successfully deployed two containerized pilot systems and are conducting validation projects with industrial partners. We are now building the team that will carry this from working prototype to industrial standard, and we are looking for the people who want to build it with us.

The Role

As Technical Founder's Associate, you will work directly with the founding team on our core technology. Over the coming months our separation geometry will be tested with pilot partners. You will be one of the people who builds the test setup, runs the measurements, and turns the results into something we can act on. We are looking for someone who finds that interesting rather than alarming. title: CRM Manager:in (w/m/div), in Vollzeit, in Berlin, ab sofort
description: Du willst deine Leidenschaft für CRM und Kundenbindung in einem Unternehmen ausleben, für dessen Vision du brennst? DR. VIVIEN KARL ist ein junges, schnell wachsendes Berliner Startup, das den Markt der Intimpflege mit natürlichen, wissenschaftsbasierten und ästhetischen Produkten aufmischt.     Der Bestandskundenbereich ist einer der wichtigsten Bereiche in unserem Unternehmen – und genau hier wollen wir in den kommenden Jahren enorm wachsen. Entsprechend groß ist die Verantwortung und der Anspruch bei dieser Rolle: Wir suchen eine erfahrene CRM-Persönlichkeit, die unser CRM eigenverantwortlich führt – strategisch denkt, tief in den Zahlen steckt und trotzdem selbst E-Mails und Kampagnen operativ umsetzt. Du führst eine Werkstudentin und gestaltest maßgeblich, wie wir mit unseren Kundinnen kommunizieren.   Aufgaben     Du verantwortest unser CRM End-to-End: Strategie, operative Umsetzung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung über all unsere Owned-Channels (E-Mail, WhatsApp, Print-Mailings).     Du baust, testest und optimierst unsere Lifecycle-Flows entlang der gesamten Kundinnenreise (u. a. Cross-Sell, Replenishment, Winback) und hebst so systematisch Kundenbindung und Customer Lifetime Value.     Du entwickelst zielgruppenspezifische Kampagnen und Newsletter von der Idee bis zum Versand: Konzept, Copy, technische Umsetzung und A/B-Testing – hands-on in Klaviyo.     Du steuerst unsere Segmentierung auf Basis von Verhaltens- und Transaktionsdaten (u. a. RFM) und erkennst das ungenutzte Potenzial einzelner Segmente, quantifizierst es und entwickelst proaktiv neue Kampagnen-Ideen, um sie zu reaktivieren und zum Wiederkauf zu bewegen     Du machst Performance messbar: Du baust Reportings und Analysen zu Kohorten, Churn und CLV/CAC und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.     Du führst und entwickelst deine Werkstudentin: Du verteilst Aufgaben klar, gibst regelmäßig Feedback und baust das Team perspektivisch weiter auf.     Du arbeitest eng mit dem Performance-Marketing Team und den Gründerinnen zusammen und spielst deine Erkenntnisse aktiv ins Team zurück.     Qualifikation     Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium (BWL, Marketing o. ä.) und mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im CRM-, Lifecycle- oder Retention-Marketing, idealerweise in einem D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld.     Du kennst Klaviyo und Shopify aus dem Effeff – Flows, Segmentierung, dynamische Inhalte, A/B-Tests, Deliverability und Reporting.     Du denkst analytisch, hast eine echte Affinität für Zahlen und übersetzt Daten souverän in Entscheidungen; Kohorten-, Retention- und CLV-Analysen sind für dich Alltag.     Du bist genauso strategisch wie hands-on: Du entwickelst die Roadmap und setzt sie am nächsten Tag selbst um.     Du arbeitest routiniert mit KI und hast den hohen Anspruch, all deine operativen, sich wiederholenden Prozesse zu automatisieren.     Du bist ein Kommunikations- und Schreibtalent, liebst die deutsche Grammatik und schreibst Copy, die konvertiert.     Du bringst Ambiti

title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
description: Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Schichtplanung im Gesundheitswesen   Du möchtest mit deiner Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegen?  Bei Swisio entwickeln wir eine der führenden SaaS-Cloud-Lösungen für Workforce Management, Dienst- und Personalplanung – und helfen Krankenhäusern und Pflegeeinrichtungen dabei, den Arbeitsalltag für tausende Menschen zu verbessern.      Das Beste aus zwei Welten   Bei uns erlebst du die Dynamik, Gestaltungsfreiheit und kurzen Entscheidungswege eines Start-ups – kombiniert mit der Sicherheit einer profitablen Muttergesellschaft aus den Niederlanden, die seit über 20 Jahren nachhaltig erfolgreich am Markt ist.  So können wir uns voll auf Innovation und nachhaltiges Wachstum konzentrieren – ohne Abhängigkeit von externen Investoren.      Jetzt ist der perfekte Zeitpunkt einzusteigen   Wir befinden uns in einer starken Expansionsphase in Deutschland und der Schweiz. Bereits heute arbeiten renommierte Einrichtungen wie große Universitätskliniken und Krankenhausverbände mit uns – und das Wachstumspotenzial allein im DACH-Gesundheitsmarkt ist enorm.  Mittelfristig werden wir unsere bewährten Lösungen auch in andere Branchen bringen – in den Niederlanden setzen bereits Unternehmen wie  Mars ,  DHL , der  Holländische Staat  und  Tata Steel  auf unsere Technologie. Als Teil unseres Teams gestaltest du diese Erfolgsgeschichte aktiv mit.      Deine Rolle bei uns   Während wir weiter wachsen, suchen wir  Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)  um unsere DACH Kund:innen langfristig erfolgreich zu machen und gemeinsam die Zukunft der Schichtplanung zu gestalten. Als Customer Success Manager begleitest du unsere Kund:innen auf ihrer gesamten Reise: vom erfolgreichen  Onboarding über die optimale Nutzung unserer Module bis hin zur Einführung neuer Features und Updates.  Durch deine Expertise, dein Gespür für Kundenanforderungen und deine Begeisterung für moderne SaaS-Lösungen trägst du maßgeblich dazu bei, dass Organisationen ihre Planungsprozesse nachhaltig verbessern und das volle Potenzial von Swisio ausschöpfen.      Dein Impact     Kundenbeziehungen stärken:  Du bist erste Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen nach der Implementierung und begleitest sie langfristig in der Nutzung unserer Software.   Proaktive Unterstützung der Kund:innen bei neuen Software-Updates  – einschließlich Kommunikation neuer Features, Funktionsdemonstrationen und Change-Management.   Strategische Betreuung:  Analyse von Kundenkonfigurationen und Unterstützung bei optimaler Anpassung technischer Einstellungen.   Feedback & Weiterentwicklung:  Du sammelst systematisch Kundenfeedback und arbeitest eng mit Produkt- und Entwicklungsteams zusammen, um unsere Software stetig zu verbessern. Wij geloven dat planning, urenregistratie, salarisverwerking en HR-administratie uiteindelijk grotendeels vanzelf moeten gaan. Je beheert een portefeuille klanten van begin tot eind. Je helpt klanten snel en succesvol live, zorgt dat ze het maximale uit Shiftbase halen en ziet op tijd waar extra aandacht nodig is. Je werkt op basis van klantsignalen, zodat je tijd investeert waar die de meeste impact heeft.   Wat je gaat doen    Klanten succesvol live brengen. Je adviseert over de inrichting, configureert de omgeving, verzorgt de technische onboarding en zorgt dat teams met vertrouwen aan de slag kunnen.   Je eigen klantenportefeuille beheren.  Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een vaste groep klanten en weet wat er bij hen speelt. Je houdt zicht op gebruik, klanttevredenheid en verlengingen en zorgt ervoor dat je portfolio gezond blijft.   Werken op basis van klantsignalen.  Je werkt niet simpelweg een bellijst af. Je gebruikt data en signalen uit het product om te bepalen welke klanten op dat moment jouw aandacht nodig hebben en waar je de meeste impact kunt maken.   Churn voorkomen voordat het een probleem wordt.  Je herkent risico's vroeg, gaat het gesprek aan om de oorzaak te begrijpen en onderneemt actie voordat een klant afhaakt.   Accounts laten groeien.  Je ziet waar extra functionaliteiten of add-ons waarde kunnen toevoegen, bespreekt die mogelijkheden met de klant en zorgt dat commerciële kansen niet blijven liggen.   De stem van de klant vertegenwoordigen.  Je deelt terugkerende feedback en productbehoeften met Product, zorgt samen met Sales voor een soepele overdracht en helpt Marketing met inzichten die relevant zijn voor bestaande klanten.   Hoe succes eruitziet in je eerste 6 maanden     Klanten zijn snel én succesvol live. Binnen drie maanden gebruiken ze de belangrijkste onderdelen van Shiftbase, zijn hun teams aan de slag en hebben ze nog maar beperkte ondersteuning nodig.  Je klantportefeuille is gezond. Je signaleert risico's vroeg, grijpt proactief in en voorkomt dat churn pas tijdens een verlengingsgesprek aan het licht komt.  Klantsignalen krijgen snel opvolging. Je handelt verzoeken en signalen binnen de afgesproken reactietijden af en zorgt dat niets tussen wal en schip valt.  Uitbreidingskansen worden benut. Je voert door je hele portefeuille waardevolle gesprekken over add-ons en weet commerciële kansen daadwerkelijk verder te brengen.  Je draait zelfstandig onboardings. Je begeleidt implementati

About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Hjälp våra kunder att gå från information till handling   Tycker du om att se andra lyckas? Är du bra på att skapa förtroende, se nästa steg och få saker att hända? Kan du rekommendera en väg framåt – och samtidigt vara prestigelös nog att lyssna och tänka om?      Då kan du vara den Customer Success Manager vi söker till Spintr.       Spintr  är ett modernt intranät för verksamheter där många medarbetare inte sitter vid en dator – butiken, depån eller anläggningen. Du är nyfiken på hur kundens organisation fungerar, vad den vill åstadkomma och vad som kan stå i vägen – och utifrån det skapar du struktur, rekommenderar nästa steg och ser till att arbetet fortsätter framåt.     En dag leder du en workshop inför en lansering. Nästa dag analyserar du användningen hos en kund, hjälper en administratör med en konfiguration eller för viktiga kundinsikter vidare till produktteamet.  Du arbetar självständigt och tar egna initiativ, men samarbetar nära Amanda, VP Customer Experience, och kollegor inom CS teamet men även försäljning, produkt och utveckling.      Det här kommer du att göra    leda onboarding, implementationer, lanseringar och andra kundprojekt  ta fram kundplaner med mål, aktiviteter, ansvar och uppföljning utifrån kundens verksamhet och utmaningar  följa användning och kundutveckling för att tidigt se behov, risker och möjligheter  hålla utbildningar, workshops, presentationer och webbinarier  hjälpa kunderna att utveckla sin kommunikation, kunskapsdelning, utbildning och sina arbetssätt  förbereda och driva förnyelser samt identifiera relevanta möjligheter till vidareutveckling  föra in kundernas perspektiv i vårt arbete med produkt, erbjudande och arbetssätt      Starkt kundägarskap betyder inte att du gör allt själv – det betyder att du håller ihop helheten, involverar rätt personer och tar ansvar för att kunden kommer vidare.      I rollen som Customer Success Manager hos oss   Du är relationsskapande och förtroendeingivande, men vågar utmana när kunden behöver prioritera annorlunda. Du lyssnar innan du rekommenderar, är personlig, prestigelös och har nära till skratt. Samtidigt är du självgående: när du ser ett behov, en risk eller en möjlighet tar du initiativ och driver arbetet framåt. Du uppskattar ordning men kan hantera att alla processer ännu inte är färdigbyggda.      För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har    flerårig erfarenhet av Customer Success

title: Seksjonsleder Kunde
description: Vi leter etter deg!  Har du lyst til å utgjøre en forskjell? For folk rundt deg og for klima og miljø? Da vil vi høre fra deg!  Det er fint om du er:  En trygg leder som får folk til å trives og jobbe godt sammen  God til å lytte, forstå ulike perspektiver og samle folk om felles mål  God til å kommunisere og skape gode relasjoner på tvers av fagområder    Vi tilbyr  En fleksibel og travel arbeidshverdag  Bra folk og et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø  Læring, utvikling og nye muligheter  Lønn som møter kompetansen din   Trygghet gjennom gode pensjon – og forsikringsordninger  Trivselstilbud og sosiale aktiviteter     Om å jobbe sammen med oss  I Linea jobber vi hver dag for at alle våre kunder skal ha en stabil og sikker strømforsyning, og levere strøm til over 47 000 kunder.   Hos oss finner du en mangfoldig gjeng med flinke kollegaer som brenner for å gjøre en forskjell. Vi jobber hardt for å sikre at folk har strøm i stikkontaktene sine, og for at strømmen overføres på en bærekraftig måte. Vi bygger ut mest mulig skånsomt i forhold til natur og miljø.  Vi jobber like hardt for å skape en god arbeidsplass, bygget på samarbeid og fellesskap. I Linea har vi lave skuldre, vi tar sikkerhet på største alvor og det er alltid noen som stiller opp når du trenger hjelp.  Det er viktig for hele organisasjonen å kunne forbedre seg, og hos oss har du mulighet til å utvikle deg personlig og faglig.  Om stillingen  I dag får 47 000 kunder tilført strøm fra Linea. Vi forvalter hele 8000 kilometer med strømlinjer; det tilsvarer Norge på langs – 3,5 ganger! Her gjør de flinke folka i seksjon Kunde en viktig jobb: 41 engasjerte medarbeidere med ansvar for kundehåndtering i Linea. Gjennom kundeseksjonen skal vi arbeide hver eneste dag for å optimalisere kundereisen i Linea, håndtere saker og forespørsler fra kunden, og følge opp våre anlegg i de tusen hjem og bedrifter på Helgeland.  Som leder av seksjon Kunde vil et være ditt oppdrag å sette mål, drifte og utvikle for seksjonen i samhandling med egen ledergruppe. I stillingen skal du inspirere medarbeidere, bygge gode team, og drive endringer der det er behov. I tillegg vil du være del av ledergruppen i Linea, og gjennom den rollen bidra til å videreutvikle selskapet på en god måte.  Som synlig leder i Linea er dine ansatte dine viktigste kunder, og du deler uoppfordret all din kunnskap og skaper trygghet ved å være åpen om egne feil og mangler. Du arbeider aktivt for å utvikle talenter i ditt eget team, og skaper resultater gjennom dine medarbeidere. Du vurderer og prioriterer Helgeland Kraft og Lineas omdømme høyt i alle sammenheng. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Coretura is building the software backbone for the next generation of commercial vehicles - a joint venture between two of the industry's biggest players, moving at scaleup speed. As Customer Success Manager, you'll sit at the center of that relationship, turning shareholder alignment into product momentum.    Our Vision & Mission   Coretura exists to build a Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) platform that redefines how commercial vehicles are engineered, updated, and monetized - jointly owned by Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, two competitors who are betting that shared infrastructure beats separate roads. Our mission is to deliver a common platform robust enough to serve multiple OEMs, while still giving each shareholder room to differentiate and win in their own markets. This is a company in active build-mode: fast-scaling, still shaping its own structures, and defined by the ambition to make software the center of gravity in trucking.   Your Quest   Coretura serves two OEM shareholders who are simultaneously its customers, a structural setup that creates constant, real tension: whose priorities get championed first, how do you keep a platform genuinely common when both owners want to differentiate, and what happens when one side's ask risks disadvantaging the other?  On top of that, the product itself is still under creation, and that creation often means guiding a broader shift from hardware-centric thinking toward a software-first mindset. We are building the platform and bringing the customers along for the ride at the same time, which makes for a different kind of relationship than you'd have with an established product. This calls for someone who can stay close to the customer commercially and relationally, build a genuine business case for why and how they engage with the platform, set and manage realistic expectations continuously, and be comfortable challenging the customer with integrity and assertiveness, all while never losing sight of the platform's value in the eyes of the customer.  This is where the Customer Success Manager comes in. You are the person who holds the customer relationship end-to-end, deeply representing your customer's interests, building the commercial and business rationale for their engagement with the platform, and making sure that rationale is heard by the people who shape the platform. The Customer Success Manager keeps their ears & eyes close to the customer organization, actively owning and driving the customer relationship to ensure a successful SDV platform in its rollout and operation.   The Value You Bring     You turn a structural relationship into a working partnership, so the customer feels heard, represented, and commercially engaged, not just serviced.  You manage expectations proactively around a product that's still being built, keeping the customer aligned and confident even as scope and timelines evolve.  You uncover customer needs early and turn them into concrete business opportunit

Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. Own initiatives from initial problem definition through to execution and results, working closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science & Analytics, Marketing, Commercial and Finance. location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: As a Field Support Manager, you will lead and support our Field Support Representatives (FSR) across the Nordics, helping them deliver an excellent experience for our Companion Animal Group (CAG) customers. This is a field-based role, ideally located in the Nordics (Norway, Sweden, Finland, Denmark), with around 50% travel to visit teams and customers.  The Companion Animal Group (CAG) is responsible for installing and supporting our best-in-class premium instruments, including ProCyte, Catalyst One and SediVue, alongside the wider IDEXX analyzer portfolio. Our FSR team trains customers to get the most from their newly acquired instruments and provides onsite technical support when things don't go to plan. As a Field Support Manager, you'll build and develop this team so they can keep delivering excellent service across the region.   In This Role     You will lead and support the FSR team across the UK, contributing to FSR strategy, operating policies and process improvements.  You'll coach and develop individuals to deliver excellent customer experience, spotting opportunities and assigning the right resources.  You'll partner with field partners to identify opportunities and coordinate resources across the region.  You will guide territory management, helping the team prioritise and allocate their time so internal and external customers stay satisfied.  You'll join ride-alongs with field reps to provide hands-on training and individual development.  You will use data, metrics and system tools to drive efficiency and maximise customer experience.  You'll act as a change champion, supporting the team through periods of change.  You will evaluate performance and provide ongoing coaching and development opportunities.  You'll help representatives organise travel to customers, resolve issues, and keep site-visit reporting timely and accurate.  You've worked cross-functionally with other departments to coordinate work, resolve issues, and share customer feedback into product and process improvements.     Why This Role Matters   Our Field Support Representatives are often the face of IDEXX for our customers — the people who install, train and troubleshoot the instruments that help vets diagnose and treat companion animals every day. As Field Support Manager, you'll be at the heart of ensuring that team performs at its best, directly shaping the experience our customers have with IDEXX and supporting the continued growth of our European operations.   What You Need To Succeed     5-7+ years of related work experience, with in-depth experience in a supervised field or business support environment.  3+ years of supervisory experience, or a combination of supervisory and relevant product knowledge.  Experience supervising remote, multi-site teams.  Strong project management and change management experience.  Big-picture thinking, with strong reasoning and analytical skills to resolve issues.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

I vores partnerelement varetager vi drift af Kastellet og Nyboder, samt lejede faciliteter i København   Om Jobbet   Dine primære ansvarsområder  Som driftsleder får du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse af vores medarbejdere inden for rengøring, deskfunktion og postservice. Planlægge og afholde personalemøder, teammøder og løbende 1:1-samtaler med medarbejderne.  Sikre den daglige bemanding og effektiv planlægning af driften.  Følge op på kvaliteten af serviceleverancerne og sikre, at vores brugere oplever en professionel, imødekommende og ensartet service.  Arbejde systematisk med kvalitetskontrol, løbende forbedringer og optimering af arbejdsgange.  Sikre, at deadlines, aftaler og serviceniveauer overholdes, og tage ansvar for at følge op på opgaverne.  Samarbejde tæt med interne kunder, brugere og øvrige samarbejdspartnere for at sikre en velfungerende hverdag.  Håndtere daglige driftsmæssige udfordringer og træffe beslutninger, der sikrer en stabil og effektiv drift.  Vi søger en leder, der går forrest, kommunikerer tydeligt, skaber tillid og formår at kombinere fokus på mennesker med et skarpt blik for kvalitet, struktur og resultater.  Der vil forekomme aktivitet rundt i landet til alle etablissementerne og herved vil en del af arbejdet ligge uden for normal arbejdstid. title: Senior Product Operations Manager
description: Our Product, Engineering and Design teams are evolving how they work as we grow, bring our products closer together and make greater use of AI and automation.     As part of that, we’re moving closer to the “product operating model”, giving teams better customer and product insights, enabling decisions closer to the work and creating stronger connections between strategy, discovery and delivery, etc.  That’s why we’re hiring our first Product Operations Manager. You’ll build the function and shape how it develops over time.     You’ll work closely with Henrik, our VP of Product, and partner with leaders and teams across Product, Engineering, Design and the wider business. You won’t inherit a finished Product Operations setup. You’ll identify where dedicated support can create the greatest leverage, build on what already works, and establish an approach that fits Zensai. This is an enablement role: you’ll improve the information, systems and operating rhythm around product work without taking craft or product decisions away from the teams that own them.      What You’ll Be Doing    Create clarity and alignment across Product, Engineering and Design.  Bring customer feedback, product usage and business data together so teams can identify the right problems, test ideas earlier and make informed product decisions.  Improve how teams prioritise, plan roadmaps, run discovery and coordinate work across Product, Engineering and Design  Take ownership of the tools and shared practices that support product discovery, feedback, insights and delivery  Connect product initiatives to business and financial impact, including supporting CAPEX/OPEX reporting  Find practical ways to use AI, agents and automation across discovery and delivery, reducing recurring operational work and helping reshape how product work gets done.       What Success Looks Like    Teams can easily find and use the customer, product and business information they need  Product decisions have a clear rationale, and teams can see how customers respond to what we build  Prioritisation, roadmapping and cross-functional work become more consistent and easier to navigate  AI and automation deliver improvements that teams can see and measure        What You Bring    You have strong experience in Product Operations, Product Management or a related role, including building or improving how product teams work.  You’ve worked in a mature product organisation and can use that experience to build an approach that fits Zensai  You’re comfortable working with customer, product and business data, including how data is captured and moves between systems  You have practical experience using AI, agents or automation to improve product work  You can bring people with different priorities together and influence decisions without formal authority.  You work confidently and independently in an international organisation and communicate clearly in English.       If you enjoy improving how good teams work toget

description: Viimeinen hakupäivä: 20. syyskuuta 2026    Hybridi     Työn kuvaus   Yhdistä ihmisten, asiakkuuksien ja liiketoiminnan johtaminen.   Me Aspialla olemme talous- ja palkkahallinnon edelläkävijöitä. Uteliaisuus, kasvu ja jatkuva kehittyminen ohjaavat tekemistämme – haluamme olla askeleen edellä niin osaamisessa kuin asiakaskokemuksessa. Avoin ja joustava työympäristömme tarjoaa sinulle mahdollisuuden kasvaa asiantuntijana.   Sytytkö ihmisten johtamisesta, asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä ja kasvun rakentamisesta? Johdat kokonaisuuttasi tavoitteellisesti, mutta et yksin: tukenasi ovat kollegat ja laaja asiantuntijaverkosto. Arjessasi yhdistyvät operatiivinen johtaminen ja pidemmän aikavälin kehittäminen. Olet lähellä tiimiä ja asiakkaita, tunnistat kehitys- ja kasvumahdollisuuksia sekä viet asioita käytäntöön yhdessä muiden kanssa.   Myynti ja kasvu    Roolissa on myynnillinen vastuu osana asiakkuuksien kehittämistä ja liiketoiminnan kasvua. Myynti muodostuu sekä nykyisten asiakkuuksien pitkäjänteisestä kehittämisestä että uusien mahdollisuuksien edistämisestä. Osallistut aktiivisesti asiakastilanteisiin ja liiketoiminnan kasvattamiseen. Olet mukana ratkaisujen rakentamisessa ja tarjousten valmistelussa yhdessä myyjien ja asiantuntijoiden kanssa.   Tiimin johtaminen    Johdat palkka-asiantuntijoita valmentavasti ja tuet heidän ammatillista kasvuaan, priorisoit tekemistä ja rakennat arkea, jossa tavoitteet ovat ymmärrettäviä ja onnistuminen mahdollista. Osaat tehdä päätöksiä, tarttua haastaviinkin tilanteisiin ja samalla vahvistaa luottamusta sekä yhdessä tekemistä.   Aspian arvot, yhteistyö, uteliaisuus ja välittävä neuvonantajuus, näkyvät tavassasi toimia niin tiimin kuin asiakkaiden kanssa. title: SodaStream: Director International Key Account & Sales Excellence Lead
description: Overview   This role is responsible for building and institutionalizing  World-Class Customer Engagement (WCCE)  across all B&M key accounts within SodaStream, driving a step-change in how the organization engages with retailers globally. It leads the development and execution of the WCCE vision and roadmap, embedding a structured, insight-driven approach to Key Account Management (KAM) across markets.  The role drives global KAM capability uplift by defining and deploying standardized frameworks, including Joint Business Planning (JBP), negotiation playbooks, and customer segmentation tools, supported by robust training, certification, and coaching programs. It establishes enterprise-wide standards for customer planning across financials, promotion architecture, assortment, and on-shelf execution, ensuring consistency and excellence in execution.  In parallel, the role owns strategic pan-European, shaping long-term commercial agendas with key customers.
